questions.answer: Aster lacks a closed-position endpoint, so Wick Hunter rebuilds trades from the account ledger. Entry fees that cannot be tied to an individual trade are left out rather than assigned incorrectly.

questions.question: If an older WEEX fill is downloaded, will it disappear when it leaves the API window?
questions.answer: No. Older records already downloaded stay on the Wick Hunter installation even after WEEX’s API no longer returns them.

questions.question: Can a timed DCA fire while its bot is stopped?
questions.answer: No. Timed DCAs are checked on the bot’s own clock and only fire while the bot is running; unlike static and ATR ladder orders, they cannot rest on the exchange.

questions.question: Does the Liq Scalper name field change the pair filters?
questions.answer: No. The name is a display label only. Pair eligibility is controlled by the bot’s saved filters.

questions.question: If I set Direction to Long only, what happens to a sell-side liquidation?
questions.answer: The bot’s direction setting filters out entries on the disallowed side. Check the event’s refusal reason in Activity if you expected it to open.

questions.question: What does Max open deals count?
questions.answer: It limits the number of deals this bot may hold open at once. It is separate from account-wide or pair-specific limits.

questions.question: Why does my Pairs section say some rules are incomplete?
questions.answer: A rule has been enabled or started but lacks a required value. Open the group; the form reports active and incomplete rules and identifies the field to finish.

questions.question: Will collapsing a pair-filter group turn its rules off?
questions.answer: No. Collapsing only hides the controls. The saved filter remains active until you change and save it.

questions.question: Does a volatility rule look at the average of several candle moves?
questions.answer: No. It checks each of the last N closed candles separately; any one candle above the maximum move excludes the pair.

questions.question: Can I use both a short and a long volatility timeframe?
questions.answer: Yes. The filter is a list of timeframe rows, so each configured row is checked. Existing rows can be removed or edited like other rows.

questions.question: Why did a coin with high midnight volume fail the rolling-volume filter?
questions.answer: The rule measures the last 24 hours counted back from now, not a midnight-reset daily total. Compare the rolling value from the selected exchange.

questions.question: Does a blank market-cap floor exclude coins without a market-cap value?
questions.answer: A blank minimum floor turns the filter off. If you set a floor and the app cannot read a coin’s market cap, the pair is refused by name rather than guessed.

questions.question: Does Min leverage set the leverage used for the order?
questions.answer: No. It checks whether a pair supports at least the configured maximum leverage on the selected exchange. The deal’s leverage setting is separate.

questions.question: How often does Wick Hunter retry missing volatility windows?
questions.answer: The app retries requested missing or stale Hub windows every five minutes until the exchange fills them.

questions.question: Why do I see fewer pairs after an auto-refresh?
questions.answer: The list is rebuilt from the current exchange data and saved filters. Review the read-only panels to see which filter excluded each pair.

questions.question: What does the liquidation trigger setting decide?
questions.answer: It decides how large a forced-liquidation event must be before the bot may treat it as an entry signal. It does not set order size.

questions.question: What happens if a liquidation feed reports an event for another symbol format?
questions.answer: The bot needs the matching symbol on its own selected exchange and product. A symbol that cannot be mapped to the traded market will not become a valid price decision.

questions.question: Does the Base order percentage update if my wallet grows during a deal?
questions.answer: No. It is resolved once when the deal opens and then held constant for that deal.

questions.question: How do I know whether my DCA volume scale makes later orders too large?
questions.answer: Read the generated ladder preview and add the base order plus every DCA amount to estimate total exposure. The Summary panel does not cap that total.

questions.question: Can a trailing take profit place an order before its activation condition?
questions.answer: The trailing mode waits for its configured activation before it follows price. Check the activation field and status to see whether it is active for the deal.

questions.question: What is the practical difference between turning stop loss off and setting a wide stop?
questions.answer: Off means there is no configured automatic stop-loss exit. A wide stop still places or monitors an exit at its configured threshold; it does not behave like off.

questions.question: Are the worked-example order values safe for my account balance?
questions.answer: They are examples of the arithmetic, not safe recommendations. Calculate your own worst-case base-plus-DCA exposure and review the stop behavior before enabling live trading.

questions.question: Does the Optimized bot use the same watched pairs as the Liq Scalper?
questions.answer: It has its own pair scope and filters. Review the Optimized bot’s Pairs settings rather than assuming another bot’s watch list applies.

questions.question: Can Optimized Liquidation use pair filters different from Liq Scalper?
questions.answer: Yes. Its guide describes its own per-exchange pair filters. Configure and review that bot’s filter panel independently.

questions.question: Why can the Optimized bot exclude a pair even though the Liq Scalper includes it?
questions.answer: The Optimized bot evaluates its own pair conditions and history requirements. A pair’s eligibility in one bot does not guarantee eligibility in the other.

questions.question: Can setting a longer lookback exceed the server’s available memory?
questions.answer: It can increase the history the bot retains. Check the memory budget guidance for your server before raising the lookback.

questions.question: Does warm-up mean the Optimized bot is broken?
questions.answer: Not by itself. Warm-up means the required history is not ready yet. Check Activity and the bot card for progress or a specific data error.

questions.question: Does the TV Signal bot limit the number of open deals?
questions.answer: Yes. Its direction, pair scope, and deal caps are checked before a signal reaches the exchange. Recent signals shows which limit refused an alert.

questions.question: Can a TV Signal bot trade a pair that is not on its allowlist?
questions.answer: No. A signal outside the bot’s configured pair scope is refused before an order is sent.

questions.question: Does changing the TV Signal bot name change its private webhook path?
questions.answer: No. The webhook URL is fixed for the life of the bot and is not rebuilt when you rename the bot.

questions.question: Can I include markdown or a comment after the TV Signal payload?
questions.answer: No. Send the documented message as the complete alert message. Extra text can make the payload fail validation.

questions.question: Does a TV Signal close action need a symbol?
questions.answer: The documented close-everything action is an exception and does not need a symbol. Other symbol-specific actions need the exact market symbol.

questions.question: Is the TV Signal order amount based on the size that actually filled?
questions.answer: The deal is managed from the amount that filled. If the webhook includes size, it overrides Base order for that deal; later management uses actual fills.

questions.question: Are TV Signal DCA distances measured from the first entry?
questions.answer: The shared DCA engine uses the configured static ladder measured from the original deal opening price; it is not re-measured after fills.

questions.question: Does TV Signal use the shared stop-loss behavior?
questions.answer: Yes. Its deals use the shared exit engine, subject to the chosen take-profit and stop-loss settings and the selected venue’s order support.

questions.question: Why did my TradingView alert open the wrong side?
questions.answer: Check the payload action and the bot’s Direction setting. A long-only or short-only setting filters out the opposite direction and Recent signals records the refusal.

questions.question: The bot says my symbol has no live price. What should I fix?
questions.answer: Check the exact exchange symbol and quote currency in the message. A mismatched symbol often cannot be found in the selected market’s price feed.

questions.question: Will TV Signal retry an alert that failed while the bot was paused?
questions.answer: No. A paused bot refuses the alert instead of queueing it for later. Resume it before sending a new alert.

questions.question: Does Manual Bot have a setting for which direction to adopt?
questions.answer: Yes. Its direction scope can allow long positions, short positions, or both. A position outside that scope is left alone.

questions.question: Can I limit Manual Bot to selected pairs?
questions.answer: Yes. Set Pairs to the desired scope. The Activity log records when an out-of-scope pair is left alone.

questions.question: When do Manual Bot ladder changes affect a deal it already manages?
questions.answer: The guide says the ladder and exit settings govern positions picked up from then on. To change a running deal, edit that deal rather than assuming a bot form save replans it.

questions.question: Why might Manual Bot take over a position after waiting 45 seconds?
questions.answer: If its order record says one of Wick Hunter’s bots opened the position but no bot is managing it, Manual Bot waits at least three checks and 45 seconds for a restarting bot to reload. It then takes over with a notice; if the records cannot be read, it does not take over on that basis.

questions.question: How can I tell whether Manual Bot skipped my position because of its pair settings?
questions.answer: Look in Activity for the “Left alone” entry naming the pair or direction scope that excluded the position.

questions.question: Why does Manual Bot refuse adoption when it cannot read unfinished order records?
questions.answer: It blocks adoption on that market rather than guessing whether an unresolved submission created a position. Review the named file or support reason before retrying.

questions.question: Do positions remain managed after I disable Manual Bot?
questions.answer: Existing positions remain managed through their configured exits. Disabling stops new adoption; it does not mean the bot abandoned current deals.

questions.question: What happens to a Manual Bot TP ladder step below the exchange minimum size?
questions.answer: The guide says undersized steps merge forward into the nearest earlier step, so the configured ladder still covers the whole position. Review the resulting ladder before saving.

questions.question: Does an exchange position’s original opening time affect Manual Bot’s DCA anchor?
questions.answer: The ladder is based on the position’s average entry when Manual Bot picks it up; the bot does not choose a new opening price for that trade.

questions.question: Where can I see the Manual Bot’s complete adoption and exit example?
questions.answer: Use the Manual Bot worked example. It shows the position at pickup and how the saved DCA and exit values apply; its figures are illustrative, not a recommendation.

questions.question: What should I verify after a Manual Bot adopts a trade?
questions.answer: Check the Managing now panel and confirm the take-profit is resting. Review any UNPROTECTED alert and the stop settings, because its app-managed stop needs the server online.

questions.question: Will Hedge Bot open a hedge if the main position is profitable?
questions.answer: It opens tranches when configured adverse-move levels are reached. A profitable main position that has not crossed a level does not trigger a hedge tranche.

questions.question: Can Hedge Bot manage a position if I only have Auto-attach disabled?
questions.answer: Without auto-attach, it does not automatically adopt every eligible position. Use the documented attachment controls to select what it is allowed to watch.

questions.question: Does Hedge Bot choose its long-main settings again after a DCA fill?
questions.answer: No. The guide says the settings column is chosen when the hedge attaches and does not change later.

questions.question: Do Hedge Bot ladder levels stay fixed after the main position averages down?
questions.answer: No. Hedge distances are measured from the current blended average, so a DCA fill, manual add, or partial close can reprice every unreached level.

questions.question: Can a hedge level request less total size than a previous level?
questions.answer: The ladder represents the total hedge desired at each level. Check the ordered levels and generated behavior before saving; a lower later total may not add exposure.

questions.question: What does the hedge level’s optional Max w/o stop override?
questions.answer: It sets the unstopped size budget for that level instead of using the global budget while price is at that level.

questions.question: Does a hedge tranche get a stop as soon as it opens?
questions.answer: No. A tranche opens unprotected and must reach its configured arming condition before an actual stop exists.

questions.question: Why is a profitable hedge still counted against Max w/o stop?
questions.answer: Profit alone does not mean it is protected. Until the stop is armed, the tranche remains unprotected and counts against the size budget.

questions.question: Is Max w/o stop measured in number of orders?
questions.answer: No. It is a size budget, measured as a share of the main position, for hedge exposure that has no stop.

questions.question: Why did the Hedge Bot stop adding tranches when its size budget looked available?
questions.answer: Check whether the per-level budget overrides the global cap, whether a minimum tranche applies, whether a stop is armed, and whether the exchange refused the order. Read the Active hedge panel for the live reason.

questions.question: If a hedge opens, does the main take-profit stay as the only exit?
questions.answer: No. Once a hedge leg opens, the paired take-profit governs the combined main and hedge position as one exit.

questions.question: Can the Hedge Bot close just the hedge while leaving the main deal open at paired TP?
questions.answer: The paired take-profit is one watched exit condition for the whole pair. When reached, Wick Hunter attempts market closes for the main and remaining hedge legs; actual fills occur on the exchange.

questions.question: Can hedge trailing move a stop farther away from profit?
questions.answer: The trail follows favorable price movement according to its configured settings. Check the arming, activation, and offset fields to see how it will move before enabling it.

questions.question: Does hedge trailing start before the tranche stop is active?
questions.answer: No. It only applies to stops already armed; an unprotected tranche remains unprotected until its stop activation condition is met.

questions.question: Can I set a different hedge DCA threshold for each deal bot?
questions.answer: Yes. The advanced settings list deal bots on the account so you can set a per-bot minimum; a blank bot row uses the catch-all threshold.

questions.question: What is already filled in when I create the first Hedge Bot?
questions.answer: A new install starts the Hedge Bot form with the Moderate template. Review the populated ladder, budgets, arming, paired target, and trailing values before saving.

questions.question: Can I switch from Moderate to Slow after creating a Hedge Bot?
questions.answer: Yes. Select another template to fill the form with that starting configuration, review the values, then save the settings.

questions.question: Which hedge settings support per-pair overrides?
questions.answer: The guide lists selected hedge settings that can be overridden for a pair. Use the Setting selector to see which values are available rather than assuming every field can differ.

questions.question: Do hedge overrides affect all positions on the account?
questions.answer: No. A per-pair override applies to the specified symbol; other pairs continue using the saved global hedge settings.

questions.question: Why does Hedge Bot only support USDT perpetual futures?
questions.answer: It needs a venue that can hold a long and a short on the same symbol simultaneously, with the required position mode and supported stop behavior.

questions.question: Does “covered in code” mean a hedge venue has been live-traded?
questions.answer: No. The venue notes distinguish deterministic code coverage from a live-account order test. Follow the live-evidence note for the selected venue.

questions.question: Should I start with large hedge size on a venue without live verification?
questions.answer: No. Follow the venue note and start with the smallest permitted amount after confirming account mode and order permissions. Support cannot guarantee exchange behavior.

questions.question: Can I change the candle interval without losing the expanded hedge chart?
questions.answer: Yes. Changing timeframe keeps the selected hedge chart and its zoom context while changing the displayed candle interval.

questions.question: What does the Active hedge panel show for a selected deal?
questions.answer: It shows the selected position’s live hedge state and settings alongside the chart, including hedge lines and planned ranges where available.

questions.question: Are the Hedge Bot example percentages guaranteed to be safe?
questions.answer: No. They illustrate how the fields interact. Choose settings within your own risk limits and account constraints; the example is not a recommendation.

questions.question: How do I know the selected Hedge Bot is the one I am editing?
questions.answer: Check the selector at the top of Hedge settings before changing fields, then use the save status line to confirm which settings were applied.

questions.question: What should I verify at the exchange before enabling Hedge Bot?
questions.answer: Confirm the market is a supported USDT perpetual and the account is in Hedge Mode. Review the venue-specific stop and order notes before enabling a strategy.

questions.question: Do DCA levels move when earlier orders fill?
questions.answer: No. Static DCA distances stay anchored to the original deal open price; earlier fills change the average entry but do not move remaining levels.

questions.question: Can several DCAs fill with no pause between them?
questions.answer: Yes. There is no minimum time or cooldown between levels; a fast candle can touch and fill several orders in sequence.

questions.question: What is the difference between Static and Scaled ATR DCA?
questions.answer: Static uses the configured deviation for the first level on every pair. Scaled ATR calculates that first distance from each pair’s recent ATR, bounded by configured minimum and maximum values.

questions.question: Why can a missing ATR feed stop a deal from opening?
questions.answer: The entry is refused when required ATR history is missing, stale, or unsupported. The bot avoids substituting a static distance you did not choose.

questions.question: Does ATR use the VWMA length setting?
questions.answer: No. ATR timeframe and length are separate from the VWMA settings because ATR sizes the ladder while VWMA controls entry timing.

questions.question: When does the bot calculate ATR DCA distances?
questions.answer: It calculates the ladder once when the deal opens. Later changes in pair volatility do not move the levels already set for that deal.

questions.question: Can I place a Scaled ATR DCA from the preview alone?
questions.answer: No. The preview uses candles downloaded for the screen and is marked Preview only; it is not yet a ladder the bot can place. The guide says the live price may shift slightly after the bot warms that pair.

questions.question: Why is a minimum deviation important for a quiet pair?
questions.answer: Without a floor, ATR can put the first DCA inside ordinary price noise, causing it to fill before the intended move.

questions.question: Why is an ATR maximum important for a volatile pair?
questions.answer: Without a ceiling, the first DCA may be placed so far away that it never fills. Review the pair preview and set a maximum if that is not intended.

questions.question: Does Volume scale multiply the first DCA or the gap between levels?
questions.answer: It multiplies the order size at successive levels. Step scale controls the gap between levels; the two settings affect different parts of the ladder.

questions.question: Can I review the final dollar amount of every DCA order?
questions.answer: Yes. The generated ladder preview shows the resulting order sizes and levels from the values you entered.

questions.question: Does the Base order control the size of a DCA order?
questions.answer: No. Base order sizes the opening trade. The DCA section configures later averaging orders separately.

questions.question: If the Summary panel says my exposure is high, does the bot refuse to save?
questions.answer: No. The panel is informational arithmetic. You must adjust the settings yourself; it does not enforce a maximum.

questions.question: How do I estimate the full exposure of a DCA ladder?
questions.answer: Add the base order and every configured DCA size, then account for the deal caps and leverage separately. The guide’s worked example shows the ladder arithmetic.

questions.question: What price anchors a Manual Bot DCA ladder?
questions.answer: The adopted position’s average entry at the time it is picked up. The ladder is calculated once and is not re-planned from later average changes.

questions.question: Does a TV Signal DCA use the same ladder engine as Liq Scalper?
questions.answer: Yes. The TV Signal guide points to the shared DCA ladder behavior; its alert controls the entry, and the common deal engine manages later DCA orders.

questions.question: When I drag a take-profit line, do the DCA levels move too?
questions.answer: No. Dragging a line moves only that line; the other chart lines stay at their own prices.

questions.question: Why does editing one DCA make the app replace other resting levels?
questions.answer: The remaining prices are derived from the whole ladder. The exchange cannot edit resting orders in place, so the app cancels and replaces affected levels after commit.

questions.question: Does a manual DCA edit change the bot’s DCA settings for later deals?
questions.answer: No. A Terminal edit belongs to the current deal. It does not change the bot’s template for future deals.

questions.question: When is a percent-of-balance order size calculated for a deal?
questions.answer: When the deal opens. The amount is converted to dollars once and stays fixed throughout that deal.

questions.question: Does the DCA ladder itself guarantee the deal exits at take profit?
questions.answer: No. The ladder adds exposure and changes average entry; it does not guarantee recovery. The take-profit order and market execution still determine the exit.

questions.question: Could every DCA fill before my stop-loss threshold?
questions.answer: Yes, depending on the configured distances and market move. Compare the full ladder with the selected stop basis and price before enabling the deal.

questions.question: Why should I check the ladder preview after changing Step scale?
questions.answer: Step scale changes the distance between successive levels. The preview reveals where each resulting level sits before you save the configuration.

questions.question: What happens to the opening order if it has not filled yet?
questions.answer: The DCA ladder and exits do not begin until the base order actually fills. Check the order status before assuming a deal is under management.

questions.question: Does a fixed take-profit target trail when price moves in my favor?
questions.answer: No. Fixed % places a target and does not follow market price. Use a trailing mode if you want the target to follow favorable movement.

questions.question: Why does Fixed % take profit move after a DCA fill?
questions.answer: The average entry changed, so the target is re-anchored from the new average and the reduce-only order is replaced.

questions.question: Can I choose ATR as a take-profit source?
questions.answer: The Liq Scalper guide lists ATR alongside Fixed % and Trailing for single-target mode. Review the form to see the required inputs for the selected mode.

questions.question: What does Trail % control after a trailing take profit activates?
questions.answer: After activation, Trail % sets how far the target trails behind the best favorable price reached. It tightens with favorable movement and does not loosen on a reversal.

questions.question: Can trailing take profit be used with multiple TP ladder targets?
questions.answer: The guide describes trailing as a single-target source. Check the current form’s compatibility notes before combining TP ladder settings with another mode.

questions.question: What starts the stop-loss cooldown timer?
questions.answer: Only a confirmed stop-loss fill starts it. Touching a threshold, a rejected stop order, a manual close, a take-profit, or a trailing take-profit does not start the timer.

questions.question: What does Account balance stop-loss mode use to set the trigger?
questions.answer: It uses the selected share of wallet balance as the intended loss amount, then derives a price from the position size. Check the guide’s calculation and recheck the ladder because the resulting stop can fall inside it.

questions.question: Is a stop-loss order always held at the exchange?
questions.answer: Only where the venue supports the required real reduce-only stop order. Check the selected venue’s guidance and the order status on the deal.

questions.question: Can a real stop guarantee that I exit at the trigger price?
questions.answer: No. Market conditions and venue execution affect the fill. A trigger price is not a guaranteed execution price.

questions.question: Does Manual Bot’s stop loss close at market when its trigger is touched?
questions.answer: Yes. The app watches the level and submits a plain market close when it is touched; no stop order rests at the exchange. The server and live price feed must be available for that action.

questions.question: Does the TV Signal take profit re-anchor after an add to the deal?
questions.answer: Yes. The shared exit engine re-anchors TP from the changed average after a DCA fill or manual add.

questions.question: What does Hedge Bot trailing affect?
questions.answer: It moves the stops of hedge tranches that are already armed. It does not arm a stop by itself or trail the main position’s stop.

questions.question: What does “cancellation pending” mean for the main take profit while a hedge is open?
questions.answer: It means Wick Hunter has not yet confirmed the separate main-position TP is absent from the exchange. Only “confirmed absent” proves it is gone; check the Terminal status before treating the paired target as the only venue order.

questions.question: Why is the paired target drawn even though the exchange has no order there?
questions.answer: It visualizes the combined P&L threshold Wick Hunter is watching. It is not a resting exchange TP order.

questions.question: What happens to the hedge legs when paired take profit triggers?
questions.answer: Wick Hunter attempts market closes for the main position and remaining hedge legs as part of the combined exit. Actual fills occur on the exchange.

questions.question: If stop loss is off, does the DCA ladder act as a hard loss limit?
questions.answer: No. DCA adds to a losing position and does not cap drawdown. The guide warns that a separate stop-loss switch is required for an automatic hard exit.

questions.question: Why does a take-profit setting say it is always on?
questions.answer: The Liq Scalper’s take-profit control ships enabled. Choose and verify its mode and target; do not assume the default target fits your account.

questions.question: Can a stopped bot leave a live exchange-held stop on an open position?
questions.answer: Exchange-held orders may remain at the venue independently of whether the bot accepts new entries. Verify the actual deal and order state before relying on protection.

questions.question: Does the paired TP calculation include realized hedge profits?
questions.answer: Yes. The guide says the combined figure includes realized hedge results and funding in addition to the main and open hedge P&L.

questions.question: Can I leave Hedge Bot trail turned off after a stop arms?
questions.answer: Yes. The trail switch is optional. With it off, the armed stop stays at the offset-defined position rather than following price.

questions.question: Does every bot use exactly the same TP modes?
questions.answer: No. The common deal engine is shared, but each bot’s form documents its supported choices. Check that bot’s exit section before selecting a mode.

questions.question: Why can a stop be placed before the last DCA level fills?
questions.answer: The stop and DCA prices are separate configured thresholds. Compare their actual price levels; a stop can be reached before a farther DCA level.

questions.question: Why does the P&L page leave an exchange field blank?
questions.answer: The venue did not provide enough data to verify the value. Wick Hunter leaves the gap visible rather than filling it with a guess.

questions.question: Does the P&L page count every day in my timezone?
questions.answer: No. It groups by UTC day, matching the Day P&L tile and the exchange’s day count.

questions.question: Why does total P&L not match the wallet balance change?
questions.answer: Wallet balance can include deposits, withdrawals, funding, and open-position movement. Compare the same currency basis and period, then check the exchange-specific reporting notes.

questions.question: What does USDT / USD change on the P&L view?
questions.answer: It changes the currency basis displayed for wallet or equity values. It does not alter trade execution or the exchange’s underlying records.

questions.question: How does TV Signal normalize an exchange-qualified symbol ending in .P?
questions.answer: It capitalizes the symbol, removes a prefix such as BYBIT:, strips a trailing .P and punctuation, so BYBIT:SOLUSDT.P becomes SOLUSDT. It does not convert quote currencies: SOLUSD is not SOLUSDT.

questions.question: Will hiding a Terminal panel also hide chart warnings?
questions.answer: No. Closing a panel changes the layout, but warnings remain visible. Use Panels to bring the hidden panel back; the saved layout does not change bot behavior.

questions.question: Does a completed WEEX history import prove my account’s full lifetime history is present?
questions.answer: No. WEEX exposes up to 365 days of fills. Finishing that available window does not prove lifetime completeness; the import note reports how far it reached and missing boundaries remain unresolved.

questions.question: Does completing a WEEX import prove my account never traded earlier?
questions.answer: No. Completing the available API window only means the import reached what the API exposed; it does not establish that no older account history exists.

questions.question: Can I export the selected wallet or equity history?
questions.answer: Yes. The chart CSV exports the currently selected series. Select Wallet or Equity before exporting the one you need.

questions.question: Why can Aster show dashes for a closed trade’s size or entry and exit prices?
questions.answer: Aster’s account-wide history reports realized profit and pair but may omit trade size and entry or exit prices. Wick Hunter reconstructs those fields from fills when it can; unresolved history stays blank rather than guessed.

questions.question: Does Wick Hunter use its own candle price instead of the exchange price?
questions.answer: It uses the selected exchange and product’s candles for price decisions. A different product book or venue can show different prices.

questions.question: Why do Bybit Spot and Bybit linear perpetual charts differ?
questions.answer: Spot and linear perpetuals use different Bybit books. Wick Hunter uses the book for the product selected by the deal.

questions.question: Can a liquidation feed trigger an entry using another exchange’s candle price?
questions.answer: The feed can contribute the liquidation event, but the bot evaluates it on the selected trading venue’s own symbol and price book.

questions.question: Can I tap the Home chart on a phone to see an exact sample?
questions.answer: Yes. Tapping the line reads the nearest real sample’s value and time.

questions.question: Why is a wallet history CSV cell empty?
questions.answer: The exchange did not return a wallet reading for that sample. The app preserves it as an empty cell rather than filling an estimated balance.

questions.question: When I leave Hedge view, what happens to its expanded chart?
questions.answer: Leaving Hedge view closes the embedded chart and releases the expanded view. Your hedge chart, zoom, lines, and ranges stay available while you remain in that view.

questions.question: Why are Terminal chart prices on the axis but order names on the plot?
questions.answer: Each line has a tag beside it naming the order, while the right axis remains numeric to stay readable.

questions.question: Why is the original entry line dim and missing a chart-axis tag?
questions.answer: It marks where the deal began and anchors DCA distances, but it is not a current decision level. The chart dims it and omits its tag to keep the active price axis readable.

questions.question: Can Terminal display two open deals side by side?
questions.answer: Terminal focuses on one selected open deal at a time. Select another deal to inspect it.

questions.question: Is the Terminal order ticket part of my bot’s automated signal?
questions.answer: No. It is a separate manual order tool with its own enable switch. Bot entries come from their respective configured signals.

questions.question: What order size units can I use in the Terminal ticket?
questions.answer: The ticket supports dollars, contracts, or a percentage of balance. Check the displayed size and order details before submitting.

questions.question: Does moving the paired TP line submit a venue limit order?
questions.answer: No. The paired target is watched by Wick Hunter as a combined threshold; it is not a limit order resting at that chart price.

questions.question: Does a failed Terminal commit keep the rejected price drawn?
questions.answer: No. If the venue refuses it, the line returns to the price actually resting and the exchange’s reason is shown.

questions.question: Can I stage an order change with keyboard controls?
questions.answer: Yes. The guide says order handles can be moved by mouse, finger, or arrow keys. Review & commit is required to send the staged change.

questions.question: Does Min liquidation size use the USD value of a print?
questions.answer: Yes. It is the minimum USD amount for a forced liquidation event to qualify for the trigger.

questions.question: Why does the pair list show an exclusion category switch?
questions.answer: The category switch lets you exclude a class of listings during each watch-list rebuild. Check the read-only panels to see what the filters removed.

questions.question: When does the Liq Scalper re-place its take-profit order?
questions.answer: It re-places the fixed take-profit after a DCA changes the average entry, using the new average as its reference.

questions.question: Can one Optimized bot use different bands for BTC and ETH?
questions.answer: Yes. Its bands are calculated per pair from that pair’s recent behavior, so the same bot can have different levels for each market.

questions.question: Why does an Optimized pair fail a market filter?
questions.answer: The bot applies its own per-exchange filters. Review the pair filter results and current venue data to see which rule excluded the pair.

questions.question: Should I set the longest lookback my server allows?
questions.answer: Not automatically. Longer history uses more resources. Choose a window your server can support and review the guide’s memory and candle-count examples.

questions.question: Does Wick Hunter accept a TV Signal alert over plain HTTP?
questions.answer: The setup guide requires a publicly reachable HTTPS address with a valid certificate. Do not send webhook secrets to an insecure endpoint.

questions.question: Can a renamed TV Signal bot accept alerts at its old webhook address?
questions.answer: Yes. The webhook address is fixed for that bot’s life and does not change when you rename it.

questions.question: Why was my webhook message rejected even though the URL is correct?
questions.answer: The message may have a wrong secret, wrong format, extra text, or incorrect symbol. Check the refusal in Recent signals and copy the complete bot-specific template again.

questions.question: Should I put the TV Signal secret in the alert title?
questions.answer: No. The secret belongs only in the documented alert message and must be kept private. Do not place it in a title, shared chart, or public post.

questions.question: Can Manual Bot adopt both sides of a one-way position?
questions.answer: No. It manages eligible positions under the exchange’s supported position model; a spot balance or unsupported market is left unmanaged.

questions.question: Why does Manual Bot wait when another bot has an unresolved submission?
questions.answer: The app cannot know whether the other order created a position. It blocks adoption on that market rather than assigning a pair based on a guess.

questions.question: Does a Manual Bot take-profit close the whole adopted position?
questions.answer: The percentage take-profit is a reduce-only order for the position size; ladder mode can instead close the configured portions at multiple targets.

questions.question: Is an armed hedge stop still counted in Max w/o stop?
questions.answer: No. Once a stop is armed, that tranche no longer counts against the unprotected size budget.

questions.question: Does Hedge Bot’s paired target guarantee both legs fill at the same instant?
questions.answer: No. Wick Hunter watches the combined target and then submits market closes for the main and remaining hedge legs. Actual fills occur at the exchange and are not guaranteed to be atomic.

questions.question: Does a hedge level size tell me how much new margin the next tranche uses?
questions.answer: No. Size % is the target total hedge size at that level, not the next order or its required margin. The actual margin also depends on leverage and venue rules.

questions.question: What should I do if Hedge settings still say unsaved?
questions.answer: Press Save hedge settings and read the status line. Do not assume edits took effect until the page reports that the save succeeded.

questions.question: Can Hedge Bot place the opposite leg if my exchange uses One-Way mode?
questions.answer: No. In One-Way mode an opposite order nets against the main position; the account needs Hedge Mode to hold both legs separately.

questions.question: What is the difference between Volume scale and Step scale?
questions.answer: Volume scale changes successive order sizes. Step scale changes the spacing between successive DCA levels.

questions.question: Does the first ATR DCA level use the same percentage on every coin?
questions.answer: No. Scaled ATR derives the first distance from each pair’s own recent volatility, then applies the configured minimum and maximum bounds.

questions.question: How can a too-small ATR minimum affect a DCA ladder?
questions.answer: A small floor can put the first level inside normal noise on a quiet pair, making it more likely to fill before the intended price move.

questions.question: Does Summary balance mean percentages are guaranteed not to exceed my wallet?
questions.answer: No. It reports the balance used for the form’s arithmetic, but does not constrain order size. Check the resulting dollar amounts and full ladder yourself.

questions.question: If a TV Signal alert contains an order amount, do DCA levels use that deal size?
questions.answer: The alert amount overrides Base order for the deal; subsequent DCA orders follow the saved ladder’s sizing rules from that deal’s opening amount.

questions.question: Why can a stop-loss percentage mean different prices with different offset modes?
questions.answer: The percentage is measured from the selected reference. Choose the offset basis first and use the form’s example to calculate the resulting stop price.

questions.question: Does trailing take profit move against me if price reverses?
questions.answer: A trailing target follows favorable movement according to its activation and offset, then remains tied to the best move reached. Review the guide’s trailing behavior before enabling it.

questions.question: I just heard about Wick Hunter. What exactly would I be installing?
questions.answer: A private trading server that runs on your own VPS or an optional managed VPS, connects to your exchange, and executes the rules you configure.

questions.question: Does Wick Hunter take custody of the money in my exchange account?
questions.answer: No. Your assets remain at your exchange; Wick Hunter places orders through the API credentials you add to your installation.

questions.question: Can I use Unleashed without giving the company my trading balance?
questions.answer: Yes. The software runs against your own exchange account and does not hold your funds. You still need a supported exchange account and restricted API credentials.

questions.question: Is this a signals service that tells me which trades to take?
questions.answer: No. Unleashed automates strategies and rules you choose; it does not promise a signal, recommendation, or profitable result.

questions.question: If I install the software, will it start trading by itself?
questions.answer: No. You must connect an exchange account and configure and enable a bot. Review each setting before allowing live orders.

questions.question: Why is a new bot form completely blank?
questions.answer: New bots intentionally leave numeric and name fields blank, including Hedge Bots. Choose your own pairs, sizes, and rules before saving.

questions.question: I opened a new bot form and nothing filled in. Is it still loading?
questions.answer: No. Blank numeric and name fields are expected on a new bot. Choose the required settings; Save refuses missing required values rather than guessing defaults.

questions.question: Will saving a bot silently reuse yesterday's value if I empty a field?
questions.answer: No. Clearing a required field makes Save refuse the form and name the empty field. Existing bots still open with their stored values.

questions.question: Where does the app take me after I successfully save a new bot?
questions.answer: A successful Save returns you to My Bots, where you can review the bot before enabling live automation.

questions.question: Do I have to understand every bot before I start?
questions.answer: No. Read the guide section for the bot you plan to run, including its fields, risks, and worked example, before enabling it.

questions.question: What are the five bot roles in Unleashed?
questions.answer: Liq Scalper, Optimized Liquidation, TV Signal, Manual Bot, and Hedge Bot. They share deal management, but they start or attach to positions in different ways.

questions.question: Should I connect an exchange before installing the server?
questions.answer: Install and secure your private dashboard first, then add a restricted exchange API key inside it.

questions.question: The guide shows example numbers. Are those filled into my new bot?
questions.answer: No. The examples are for learning; new bots, including Hedge Bots, start with blank numeric and name fields so you choose your own settings.

questions.question: What should I do after the dashboard first opens?
questions.answer: Confirm its HTTPS address and login, then add a restricted exchange account and validate the markets you plan to use before configuring automation.

questions.question: Can Hedge Bot protect an account that has no open position?
questions.answer: Hedge Bot attaches to an existing eligible position; it does not create the main trade.

questions.question: Does adding my dashboard to a second phone use a second licence?
questions.answer: No. A phone shortcut opens the same private server dashboard; the licence covers the server installation, not each viewing device.

questions.question: Can I preview a shared configuration before I connect an exchange?
questions.answer: Yes. My Bots → Import → Preview shows its bot type, name, and headline settings without saving it or placing an order.

questions.question: Do all bots use the same exchange connection?
questions.answer: Bots operate through the accounts and markets you connect on your private installation. Each account has its own keys and book, while deal management uses the shared engine.

questions.question: Can I connect more than one exchange account?
questions.answer: Yes. A private installation can connect multiple supported exchange accounts, each with its own credentials. The published managed-hosting offer allows up to five accounts on one instance; check current limits before purchase.

questions.question: Will two exchange accounts remain isolated if my server is compromised?
questions.answer: They are separate at the exchange, but running accounts' keys are decrypted into the same server process. Secure the host as though it can access every connected account.

questions.question: Where can I see the accounts and markets a bot can use?
questions.answer: Open Accounts to review connected accounts and their enabled markets, then inspect the bot's account and market scope before enabling it.

questions.question: If I change an account's enabled markets, must I restart Wick Hunter?
questions.answer: No. The account's market selection applies immediately when you save it.

questions.question: Does adding the dashboard to my phone install a trading bot on the phone?
questions.answer: No. Add to Home Screen opens the same server dashboard in its own window; trading still runs on your server.

questions.question: How do I add the dashboard to my iPhone home screen?
questions.answer: In Safari, use Share then Add to Home Screen. The guide notes that Chrome and Firefox on iOS cannot add this dashboard that way.

questions.question: Can I put the Wick Hunter dashboard on Android like an app?
questions.answer: Yes. Android Chrome offers Install for the dashboard. It is a shortcut to your server, so the server must remain online.

questions.question: I dismissed the phone install banner. Is it gone forever?
questions.answer: No. Dismissing it hides the banner for a week; you can still use your browser's Add to Home Screen or Install action.

questions.question: Where is Add account on a phone?
questions.answer: Open More, then Accounts, then Add account. Scroll inside the dialog if its fields extend beyond the screen.

questions.question: The Add account dialog is taller than my phone screen. How do I reach Save?
questions.answer: Scroll within the dialog to reach the remaining fields and its Add account and Cancel buttons.

questions.question: What does the guided setup actually do?
questions.answer: It walks through six screens and points out important controls. It is a read-through; Next advances without creating a key, saving a bot, or changing your settings.

questions.question: Will guided setup wait until I connect an exchange?
questions.answer: No. Next moves on even if you have not completed the action described in that step.

questions.question: How do I leave the setup tour midway through?
questions.answer: Use Skip the tour, the close X, or Escape. You can reopen it later from the same place.

questions.question: Why does the setup tour say it cannot point to a control?
questions.answer: The relevant page or control is not open or visible. Open that page, or continue the tour; it reports the missing target rather than waiting silently.

questions.question: Does a green dashboard mean my strategies are safe to run?
questions.answer: No. Verify the account connection, bot settings, open deals, and exchange orders separately before enabling automation.

questions.question: Can the software guarantee a profit if I use the recommended setup?
questions.answer: No. Trading and automation can lose capital, and results depend on your settings, exchange, liquidity, and connectivity.

questions.question: Is Unleashed financial advice or a managed account?
questions.answer: No. It is software that executes your configuration through your exchange account; you remain responsible for strategy and monitoring.

questions.question: Do Monthly, Yearly, and Lifetime unlock different bot features?
questions.answer: The plans include the same shipped software, supported exchanges, and updates. Their payment and renewal terms differ; confirm current offers at checkout.

questions.question: Is the software tied to one specific server forever?
questions.answer: No. You may move an installation with your personal install page, but a licence permits only one active installation at a time.

questions.question: Can I give my licence to a friend to run on their own server?
questions.answer: No. The licence is personal and non-transferable, and covers one installation at a time.

questions.question: Could my friend and I use one licence on two VPSs if we trade different accounts?
questions.answer: No. A licence covers one running copy on one server, regardless of the exchange accounts connected.

questions.question: Does Wick Hunter have a mobile app in an app store?
questions.answer: The documented phone option is to add your private dashboard to the home screen. It opens that server page full-screen; the software runs on the server.

questions.question: Why do I need to monitor trades if a bot runs automatically?
questions.answer: Automation follows the rules you set and can encounter exchange, connection, liquidity, or configuration problems. Review your account and open positions regularly.

questions.question: Can I try the guided setup without risking an order?
questions.answer: Yes. The tour only points out screens and controls; advancing it does not save settings or send orders.

questions.question: Is clicking Share on a bot the same as publishing a live strategy?
questions.answer: No. Share exports that bot's configuration as JSON or a link; it does not alter your account or place an order.

questions.question: Will a shared bot file include my exchange key?
questions.answer: No. The Share export carries trading settings, not API keys, webhook secrets, or Discord webhook URLs.

questions.question: What should I inspect before importing someone else's bot settings?
questions.answer: Use My Bots → Import → Preview to see the bot type, name, and headline values, then inspect the filled form. Nothing is saved until you choose Save.

questions.question: Can a bot configuration link secretly change my live bot as soon as I open it?
questions.answer: No. The link opens the Import preview. Ordinary bot configurations are not saved until you open and save their form.

questions.question: What happens if a shared configuration is too large for a link?
questions.answer: Link copying is refused with a message, but you can still copy the JSON or download the configuration file.

questions.question: Can I import a shared Hedge Bot configuration over my existing hedge?
questions.answer: Importing a shared hedge asks for confirmation and creates a new paused hedge bot with no pairs; it leaves your existing hedge bot and protected deals alone.

questions.question: Does sharing my bot settings change the source bot?
questions.answer: No. Share reads one bot's configuration for export; the source account and bot keep their current state.

questions.question: What is the safest first step before using a shared strategy?
questions.answer: Preview the imported settings, check account scope, size, DCA and exits, and save only after they suit your own exchange account and risk limits.

questions.question: Where is the install command after I buy?
questions.answer: The purchase email links to your private install page. Open it for a fresh command tied to your licence; contact support with your order reference if the email is missing.

questions.question: Can I use an install command copied from a tutorial video?
questions.answer: Use the command issued by your own personal install page. Its private token is unique to your purchase and should not be shared.

questions.question: What server do I need for self-hosting?
questions.answer: The published path calls for a supported VPS with at least 1 GB of memory and Ubuntu 22.04 or newer. Check your install page before provisioning.

questions.question: Will a VPS with 512 MB of RAM be enough?
questions.answer: The documented minimum is 1 GB. Choose a server that meets the published requirements instead of assuming a smaller one will work reliably.

questions.question: Can I install it on my Mac rather than a VPS?
questions.answer: The supported self-hosting path is an Ubuntu VPS. Ask human support before attempting an undocumented platform.

questions.question: Does a Windows laptop have to stay on for Wick Hunter to trade?
questions.answer: No. The trading service runs on the server you provision or the optional managed VPS, independently of your laptop.

questions.question: Can I choose my own VPS provider?
questions.answer: Yes. Self-host on a supported VPS that meets the install requirements, and use your personal install page for the current command.

questions.question: Who pays my Vultr or other self-hosting bill?
questions.answer: You pay your VPS provider separately from the software licence. Review the provider's billing terms and release unused resources.

questions.question: If I stop my VPS, will its bill stop too?
questions.answer: A stopped server may still cost money while resources remain allocated. Check the hosting provider's billing page before assuming charges ended.

questions.question: Can I close my laptop after the installation finishes?
questions.answer: Yes. The VPS continues running while it remains online; closing your laptop only ends your dashboard view.

questions.question: Where will I find the dashboard URL after installing?
questions.answer: The self-hosted installer prints the dashboard address when setup completes. Save that HTTPS URL privately.

questions.question: Does the installer set up HTTPS?
questions.answer: The published install flow installs the signed release and HTTPS, then prints a dashboard URL. Verify the certificate before entering credentials.

questions.question: My dashboard browser shows a certificate warning. Should I log in anyway?
questions.answer: No. Stop before entering a password or exchange key, then fix HTTPS or contact human support with the error details.

questions.question: Do I need to re-run the original install command for updates?
questions.answer: No. Signed updates are applied inside the app; the personal install page is used for installation and moves.

questions.question: Can I run the install command on a server that already hosts other apps?
questions.answer: The documented path uses a fresh supported Ubuntu VPS. Ask human support before installing on a customized shared host.

questions.question: Does the command go in my laptop terminal or on the VPS?
questions.answer: Connect to the VPS first and run the one-line command from your private install page in the server's terminal.

questions.question: The installer asks for an internal secret. Is that my exchange API key?
questions.answer: No. That secret secures the app. Add exchange API credentials later in your private dashboard; do not paste them into that prompt.

questions.question: Is my VPS root password the dashboard login password?
questions.answer: No. The server login and Wick Hunter dashboard login are separate credentials. Protect both.

questions.question: Can I buy the software first and arrange a VPS later?
questions.answer: Yes. Your software purchase provides a personal install page; provision a supported VPS before running its command.

questions.question: What does managed hosting do for me?
questions.answer: When available, the team provisions a private VPS with Wick Hunter installed and emails the dashboard address. You still connect accounts and configure bots.

questions.question: Does managed hosting include somebody choosing my trades?
questions.answer: No. Hosting covers the private server setup, not strategy selection or account management. You configure and monitor your own bots.

questions.question: Will a managed VPS arrive with my exchange credentials already loaded?
questions.answer: No. Add your own restricted exchange API keys inside its private dashboard after provisioning.

questions.question: Is the managed VPS shared with other customers?
questions.answer: The published offer describes a private server for your installation. Confirm its current specifications before purchase.

questions.question: Where can I check whether managed hosting is available today?
questions.answer: Check the current customer dashboard or checkout offer. Availability can change, so use the live catalog before paying.

questions.question: Can I add hosting after starting on my own VPS?
questions.answer: Check the customer dashboard for a current hosting offer. Export your setup and stop the old installation before the new one trades.

questions.question: Does software checkout automatically include hosting?
questions.answer: Hosting is optional and separately identified in the live checkout or customer dashboard. Confirm the total before payment.

questions.question: How many exchange accounts does managed hosting allow?
questions.answer: The published managed VPS describes up to five connected exchange accounts on one instance. Confirm current limits at checkout.

questions.question: Are managed VPS backups included?
questions.answer: The published current VPS offer says backups are not included. Check the live hosting description and keep recovery copies you need.

questions.question: When will I get my managed-hosting dashboard link?
questions.answer: It is emailed after provisioning. If it has not arrived, check the purchase message and contact human support with your order reference.

questions.question: Can I choose the region for managed hosting?
questions.answer: Available regions are a current hosting-offer detail. Check the live dashboard or checkout before ordering.

questions.question: Will cancelling managed hosting give me the VPS to keep?
questions.answer: No. Ending managed hosting does not transfer the VPS or its contents to your own infrastructure. Arrange any data move before cancelling.

questions.question: Can I move the licence to a replacement VPS?
questions.answer: Yes. Open your personal install page for a fresh one-time command, and stop the previous installation before the replacement trades.

questions.question: Does a replacement server require buying a second licence?
questions.answer: A licence is not tied forever to one server, but it permits only one active installation at a time. Use your personal install page to move it.

questions.question: How do I move all my bot settings to a new server?
questions.answer: On the old install, use Settings → Move existing setup → Export setup; import that file on the new install, then reconnect excluded secrets.

questions.question: Will the move export contain exchange API keys?
questions.answer: No. Reconnect every exchange account with its key on the new install.

questions.question: Does the move file preserve my Discord webhook URL?
questions.answer: No. The export omits the Discord webhook, so configure it again after importing.

questions.question: Do TradingView bot secrets move with the setup export?
questions.answer: No. The move file excludes TradingView webhook secrets. Reconnect them on the new install and update affected alerts.

questions.question: Can I import a setup file over an install with existing bots?
questions.answer: It first refuses and explains the overwrite risk. Review the warning before confirming an override.

questions.question: Does importing a setup file reboot the new installation?
questions.answer: Yes. The app restarts when the import lands and then lists the credentials you still need to reconnect.

questions.question: Should both my old and new servers stay online during a move?
questions.answer: Stop the old trading installation before the new one trades. The move tool cannot prevent both from acting on the same exchange account.

questions.question: Can two VPSs trade separate accounts under one licence?
questions.answer: No. The licence permits one running installation at a time, regardless of which accounts they connect.

questions.question: Will exporting setup close my open exchange positions?
questions.answer: No. Moving configuration does not close exchange positions. Review open deals and orders before stopping the old server.

questions.question: Can I send the private install link in a group chat to get help?
questions.answer: Do not share its token publicly. Describe the error and send an order reference through private support without posting the link.

questions.question: I lost my welcome email. Is the licence gone?
questions.answer: No. Contact human support with your purchase email and transaction reference to recover access to the private install page.

questions.question: The install token says it was used. What should I do?
questions.answer: Reopen your personal install page for a fresh one-time command. If that fails, ask human support without posting the token.

questions.question: Why is the dashboard IP different from my VPS console?
questions.answer: Verify the provider's server address and install output before entering credentials. If they disagree, stop and ask human support to investigate.

questions.question: Can I prepare my exchange key before the server is ready?
questions.answer: You can create a restricted key, but enter it only in the private HTTPS dashboard after installation. Do not send it in email or chat.

questions.question: Does removing the phone dashboard shortcut uninstall the server?
questions.answer: No. The home-screen shortcut is only a view of your private dashboard; the server keeps running.

questions.question: Can two phones open the same private dashboard?
questions.answer: Dashboard access depends on its URL and login; phone shortcuts are not extra software installations. Keep those credentials private.

questions.question: What happens if my software subscription lapses while positions are open?
questions.answer: The published FAQ says the installation enters exit-only mode: it protects and closes existing positions but does not open new ones until access is renewed.

questions.question: Does an expired subscription mean every order instantly stops?
questions.answer: No. Exit-only mode may still act to protect or close existing positions. Review the exchange and licence state before assuming all activity has stopped.

questions.question: How much is the Monthly software plan right now?
questions.answer: Read the current Monthly amount and currency from the live Pricing catalog and verify the charge at checkout; do not use an older quoted amount.

questions.question: What is today's Yearly price?
questions.answer: Use the live Yearly price shown on Pricing and the checkout summary. The amount can change with an active offer.

questions.question: What would Lifetime cost me today?
questions.answer: Check the live Lifetime offer and its checkout summary for the current one-time software charge and availability.

questions.question: Is there a separate managed-hosting charge?
questions.answer: Yes, when hosting is offered it is priced separately unless checkout explicitly combines it with software. Read the live hosting price before purchase.

questions.question: Which plans are actually for sale now?
questions.answer: The live public Pricing catalog lists current plan availability. Select a plan there and verify its checkout summary.

questions.question: Is the launch discount still active today?
questions.answer: Private promotion codes are validated at Stripe Checkout, which shows the accepted discount and terms before confirmation. The public free-access period for eligible card subscriptions is separate; check its current deadline in the live catalog.

questions.question: Does an offer code have to be typed manually?
questions.answer: If you have received a private promotion code, enter it in Stripe Checkout and confirm the accepted discount in the checkout summary. General visitors do not receive an automatic discount.

questions.question: What is the final price after a promotion?
questions.answer: Read the discounted amount for your selected plan from the live catalog, then confirm the final charge at checkout.

questions.question: Will a software discount also reduce my VPS bill?
questions.answer: The Terms exclude hosting and VPS charges from a software offer unless current checkout explicitly says otherwise. Check both amounts before paying.

questions.question: Can I see the entire first charge before paying?
questions.answer: Yes. Review the selected plan, any hosting, discount, currency, and total in the live checkout summary before confirming payment.

questions.question: Would a Yearly plan have a different bot selection than Monthly?
questions.answer: No. The published plans include the same shipped software and updates; check the live catalog for payment and renewal differences.

questions.question: Is Lifetime a subscription that bills me every year?
questions.answer: No. The Lifetime software licence is a one-time purchase for the life of the product; optional hosting can still renew separately.

questions.question: Does Lifetime mean I can run unlimited servers?
questions.answer: No. It covers one installation at a time, just like the other software plans.

questions.question: What if Wick Hunter Software closes while I have Lifetime?
questions.answer: The Terms promise Lifetime licence holders the complete software source code so they can continue running and maintaining it.

questions.question: Will a technical Lifetime licence-token refresh charge my card?
questions.answer: No. The Terms distinguish technical token renewal from any paid subscription renewal.

questions.question: Can I buy Yearly access with crypto?
questions.answer: Check the live Yearly checkout for a currently offered stablecoin option. If offered, it is a one-time payment rather than an automatic renewal.

questions.question: Is crypto payment available on Monthly?
questions.answer: Check the live payment options for Monthly. Do not assume a stablecoin option shown on another plan applies here.

questions.question: Does a stablecoin Yearly purchase renew automatically next year?
questions.answer: No. Where offered, stablecoin Yearly is prepaid and nonrenewing; its access end date is shown at checkout.

questions.question: How long will a prepaid crypto Yearly licence last?
questions.answer: The access-through date is the one shown at checkout for that purchase. Review it before paying.

questions.question: Can I pay for Lifetime in crypto today?
questions.answer: Check live Lifetime availability and payment methods in the catalog and checkout; a stablecoin option is not guaranteed at every time or location.

questions.question: If I cancel a Monthly plan, do I lose access immediately?
questions.answer: Cancellation stops future renewals; paid access generally continues through the current paid period, subject to applicable rights and account status.

questions.question: Where do I cancel a recurring software plan?
questions.answer: Use the billing portal linked to your account. Confirm the effective cancellation and current paid-through date there.

questions.question: Do I need to email support just to cancel?
questions.answer: Recurring plans can be cancelled in the billing portal. Contact human support if access to that portal is failing.

questions.question: Can I cancel an annual plan before its next charge?
questions.answer: Yes. Cancel through the billing portal before renewal; paid access generally continues to the current period end.

questions.question: What happens to a combined software-and-hosting bundle when I cancel?
questions.answer: The Terms say a combined Monthly or Yearly bundle cancels together. Check the current subscription in your billing portal before confirming.

questions.question: I bought Lifetime with monthly hosting. Does cancelling the software cancel hosting?
questions.answer: Lifetime software has no recurring charge; its optional hosting is a separate monthly subscription that you cancel separately.

questions.question: Can I cancel hosting but keep a valid software licence?
questions.answer: Hosting and software may be separate subscriptions. Cancelling hosting ends that service but does not transfer its VPS; check your billing portal and plan terms.

questions.question: If I cancel hosting, will Wick Hunter migrate my data to my own VPS?
questions.answer: No automatic migration is promised. Ending managed hosting does not transfer the VPS or its contents; arrange your move before cancellation.

questions.question: How do I avoid being billed for another renewal?
questions.answer: Cancel the recurring plan in the billing portal before the next renewal, then verify the confirmation and effective date there.

questions.question: Was my cancellation actually recorded?
questions.answer: I cannot see your private billing record. Check the billing portal's status and confirmation; contact human support with the account email and reference if it is unclear.

questions.question: Why did I get charged after clicking cancel?
questions.answer: The effective date and charge history are account-specific. Check your billing portal and send the charge date and invoice reference to human support for review.

questions.question: Can the assistant reverse a duplicate card charge?
questions.answer: No. Human billing support must inspect the payment records. Send the invoice references and charge dates; do not send a full card number.

questions.question: What is the refund window for a first software purchase?
questions.answer: The published voluntary policy allows a request within seven days after the first actual payment. Email the checkout address and transaction details; approval is reviewed individually.

questions.question: Does the seven-day refund clock start when I enter a card during free access?
questions.answer: No. It starts on the first actual charge, not when the payment method is collected at signup.

questions.question: Can I ask for a refund on my first Lifetime purchase?
questions.answer: Yes, request review within seven days of its checkout payment under the published voluntary policy. Approval is not automatic.

questions.question: Is a first managed-hosting payment covered by the seven-day request period?
questions.answer: The voluntary policy allows a request within seven days after the first actual hosting payment. Human support reviews the request.

questions.question: If software and hosting were bought together, what starts the refund window?
questions.answer: The first actual payment for the combined purchase starts its seven-day request period.

questions.question: Does separate hosting on a Lifetime licence get its own first-purchase window?
questions.answer: Yes. The first separate hosting payment has its own seven-day request period under the published policy.

questions.question: Are renewal charges refundable if I forgot to cancel?
questions.answer: Renewals are generally not refundable under the voluntary policy. Contact human support about your circumstances and any mandatory rights that apply.

questions.question: Will sending a refund email guarantee approval?
questions.answer: No. Requests are reviewed individually; the published voluntary policy does not guarantee approval.

questions.question: Where do I send a refund request?
questions.answer: Email admin@wickhunterunleashed.com within the applicable period. Include the checkout email, purchase date, transaction details, and a short description.

questions.question: What details should I include with a billing complaint?
questions.answer: Provide your account email, invoice or transaction reference, charge date, and a brief description. Never send the full card number or security code.

questions.question: If a refund is approved, how will I receive it?
questions.answer: It is returned through the original payment method where supported; timing depends on the payment provider and bank or wallet.

questions.question: Can you tell me whether my refund has been approved?
questions.answer: I cannot inspect private payment records. Human billing support can review your request using the checkout email and transaction reference.

questions.question: Do local consumer rights disappear because the refund policy is voluntary?
questions.answer: No. The policy says it does not limit mandatory refund, withdrawal, warranty, or other rights applicable law protects.

questions.question: Is a discount locked in forever if I cancel and rejoin later?
questions.answer: The Terms describe a recurring discount while an eligible subscription remains active. A later purchase depends on the live offer and checkout terms then.

questions.question: Will my recurring discount apply to future software renewals?
questions.answer: An eligible recurring software discount accepted at checkout continues on the active subscription according to that offer. Check your own billing summary for the applied rate; hosting is excluded.

questions.question: How much will my next renewal be?
questions.answer: That is account-specific. Check the billing portal and next invoice for your plan, discount, and any hosting charge; ask human support if they disagree.

questions.question: Can I switch from Monthly to Yearly today?
questions.answer: Open the billing portal to see the options for your subscription. If Yearly is not shown, our team can review your case. Avoid creating a second subscription while checking.

questions.question: Can I add Lifetime after paying for Yearly?
questions.answer: Check live Lifetime availability and ask human billing support how your existing entitlement would be handled before buying a second plan.

questions.question: Is tax included in the price on the marketing page?
questions.answer: Use the final checkout summary for your location and purchase. The public catalog alone does not establish your account-specific tax or total.

questions.question: Why is the charge in my bank different from the displayed USD price?
questions.answer: Compare the checkout currency and invoice with your bank's conversion or fees. Human billing support can review a mismatch using the transaction reference.

questions.question: Can I pay by bank transfer instead of card or crypto?
questions.answer: Use the live checkout for accepted payment methods. If the method you need is not shown, ask human billing support rather than sending payment details in chat.

questions.question: Do I need to create a separate Wick Hunter billing account before buying?
questions.answer: The published purchase flow uses checkout and emails a personal install page. Use the current checkout instructions for any account or verification steps it requests.

questions.question: Can support manually invoice me for a plan?
questions.answer: I cannot confirm manual invoicing from the published checkout flow. Contact human billing support to ask about an arrangement not shown there.

questions.question: Is there a free trial for every plan right now?
questions.answer: If the live launch offer is active, eligible card Monthly and Yearly software signups before its first-payment timestamp have access without charge until that timestamp; other plans and later signups follow their checkout terms.

questions.question: If checkout takes my card now but the first charge is later, when does refund eligibility begin?
questions.answer: The published voluntary window begins on the first actual payment, not when card details are collected. Verify the charge date in your billing portal.

questions.question: Can I dispute a payment without losing access?
questions.answer: The Terms say a payment dispute may cause suspension while the provider reviews it, subject to applicable law. Contact human billing support with the reference first.

questions.question: What is the difference between the public price and my invoice?
questions.answer: Public prices and offers are live catalog facts; your invoice may reflect your subscription, discount, hosting, tax, or payment timing. Human support can review your specific charge.

questions.question: Does stopping the software cancel my subscription?
questions.answer: No. Stop the recurring charge in the billing portal; shutting down a VPS or uninstalling the app does not cancel billing.

questions.question: What permissions should I grant an exchange API key?
questions.answer: Use read and trade permissions needed for your selected market. Keep withdrawals and transfers disabled and restrict the key to your server IP where supported.

questions.question: Should I enable withdrawal access so the bot can take profit?
questions.answer: No. Take-profit orders use trading permission; withdrawal access is unnecessary and should stay disabled.

questions.question: Can I leave transfer permission on because I might move collateral?
questions.answer: The security guidance recommends disabling transfer permission on bot keys. Use a separate exchange workflow for transfers.

questions.question: Is an exchange API secret the same as my dashboard password?
questions.answer: No. The API secret authorizes exchange requests; the dashboard password protects the app login. Store both separately and never paste either into support chat.

questions.question: Should the key be IP restricted to my server?
questions.answer: Yes, where your exchange supports an IP allowlist. Use the server's public IP and update the allowlist if that IP changes.

questions.question: My server IP changed. Could that break the exchange connection?
questions.answer: Yes. An IP-restricted key can be refused from a new address. Confirm the VPS public IP and update the exchange allowlist before revalidating.

questions.question: Can I use a live API key in an exchange demo environment?
questions.answer: No. The key must be issued inside that venue's own demo environment; a live key will not authenticate against it.

questions.question: Which exchanges have a demo option in the account form?
questions.answer: The guide documents Demo for Bybit Demo Trading and Bitget paper trading. The Environment control appears only for a venue with a supported demo mode.

questions.question: Does a demo account share my live orders and positions?
