questions.answer: No. It appears as a separate DEMO account and keeps demo orders, positions, and P&L separate from live.

questions.question: Why does the demo chart show the live exchange's market data?
questions.answer: Demo account orders and P&L stay in demo, but candles, market data, and the liquidation feed come from the real exchange.

questions.question: Can I test every supported exchange without real funds?
questions.answer: No. The guide documents demo accounts for Bybit and Bitget; do not assume other venues provide a supported demo environment.

questions.question: Do I have to select the exchange market when adding an account?
questions.answer: Yes. Each selected market is checked separately against the venue, and a failed market is left out of the run plan until you fix and save it again.

questions.question: What happens if one market validates but another does not?
questions.answer: The valid market can be retained, while the failing market is excluded from the run plan with a warning. Fix its permission and save again.

questions.question: Will Wick Hunter place a test order just to validate my key?
questions.answer: No. Connection checks use exchange reads and capability flags; the guide explicitly says no test order is placed.

questions.question: Why did my account save with a warning instead of refusing?
questions.answer: Some capability failures are shown on the account card so you can correct them at the exchange and revalidate. Check the named market and permission.

questions.question: Does adding an account automatically turn on every market?
questions.answer: No. The markets you select are validated individually, and only successful ones enter the run plan.

questions.question: Where should I check whether a connected account can trade?
questions.answer: Read the account card's validation and trading warnings, then verify the exchange key permissions and account mode before running a bot.

questions.question: Can I add several exchange accounts with separate API keys?
questions.answer: Yes. Each account has its own keys, book, and market selection, though all running keys are held in the same server process.

questions.question: Will changing markets on an account require a reboot?
questions.answer: No. Market selection changes apply immediately when saved on the account.

questions.question: What happens to my bots if I remove their exchange account?
questions.answer: The bots remain in My Bots but have nowhere to run. Review them there; eligible orphaned bots can be retired.

questions.question: Does removing an account cancel its open exchange orders?
questions.answer: No. Removal deletes stored keys and stops app access; it does not cancel orders or close positions. Review the exchange first.

questions.question: Could I remove an account while it still has live exposure?
questions.answer: The app warns about open deals, armed hedge stops, and uncertain submissions, then asks again. You can override, but the exchange exposure remains yours to manage.

questions.question: If I remove an account, can Wick Hunter still fire its stop?
questions.answer: No. Once its key is removed, the app cannot reach that account. Check exchange-side orders and positions before removal.

questions.question: What does Remove account erase locally?
questions.answer: It deletes stored API keys and clears that account's run plan and market caps; it does not erase exchange positions.

questions.question: Does an account-removal override leave any record?
questions.answer: Yes. Activity and notifications record the account, market, and what exposure was left behind.

questions.question: Can I retire a bot left behind by a removed account?
questions.answer: Yes. My Bots lists orphaned bots with a Retire action so they no longer count against bot limits. Check the warning if that bot ever traded.

questions.question: Does Retire close orders from an orphaned bot?
questions.answer: No. Retiring changes this installation's bot list, not the exchange. Check the exchange for any remaining order or position.

questions.question: Why does an orphaned bot still appear in P&L after retirement?
questions.answer: Retirement keeps its name for historical closed trades, so P&L can still identify the bot.

questions.question: Can I retire a bot while its account is still connected?
questions.answer: No. Retire is for bots stranded by a removed account. Delete a connected bot from its own card, subject to open-deal checks.

questions.question: Why is an orphaned bot warning stronger if it once placed orders?
questions.answer: The app can no longer inspect its old exchange account, so you must check what it might have left there before retiring it.

questions.question: I added a second account, but only one appears on a bot form. What should I inspect?
questions.answer: Check that the second account's intended market validated and is enabled, then confirm the bot supports that account and market.

questions.question: Does a connected exchange account give Wick Hunter permission to withdraw?
questions.answer: Only if you grant that permission at the exchange. Do not grant it; the software needs restricted read and trade access for its supported workflows.

questions.question: Can support inspect my exchange account directly if an order failed?
questions.answer: Do not send API secrets. Use the account card warnings, Activity, and a redacted bug report; human support can review evidence you choose to share.

questions.question: Can I leave the old installation trading while I connect the same account on a new one?
questions.answer: No. Stop the old server before the new one trades; the move tool does not fence two installations acting on the same exchange account, and one licence permits one running installation.

questions.question: What if I entered a key for the wrong exchange?
questions.answer: Remove or correct the mismatched account credential and create the key at the exchange selected in the form. Revalidate before enabling a bot.

questions.question: Aster's connection form asks for an API wallet. Is that a normal API key?
questions.answer: No. Aster uses a Pro API wallet with an address and private key, plus your master account wallet address; older V1 key fields are not used.

questions.question: Where do I create the Aster credential Wick Hunter accepts?
questions.answer: In Aster's Pro API area, create an API wallet. Enter its address, private key, and your master account wallet address in the matching fields.

questions.question: Why can I not find an Aster API key and secret on the current page?
questions.answer: The guide says Aster stopped issuing V1 keys; the current connection uses an API wallet address and private key instead.

questions.question: I only copied my Aster API wallet address. Can I reconnect without the private key?
questions.answer: The private key is shown once. If it was not saved securely, create a new API wallet and use its new pair.

questions.question: Does my Aster master wallet address authorize trades by itself?
questions.answer: No. It identifies the master account for shared order-limit pacing; the API wallet private key signs trading requests.

questions.question: Which Aster address belongs in the master-account field?
questions.answer: Use the wallet address you log in to Aster with, not the newly created API wallet address.

questions.question: What happens if I paste the Aster API wallet address into the master field?
questions.answer: The app refuses that exact mix-up and points to the master-address field, because the two addresses serve different purposes.

questions.question: Why is Aster asking for three credential fields?
questions.answer: It needs the API wallet address, its one-time private key, and the master wallet address used to group order limits for that account.

questions.question: Does Wick Hunter send my Aster master wallet address with every order?
questions.answer: No. The guide says that address is used locally to group Aster wallets under the account's shared order budget.

questions.question: Can two Aster API wallets share the same master address?
questions.answer: Yes. Aster counts its order limit per master account; that address lets Wick Hunter pace wallets from the same account together.

questions.question: My old Aster account has no master address saved. Must I rotate its key?
questions.answer: No. Edit account now lets you add the master wallet address on its own without changing the API wallet pair.

questions.question: Can I rotate an older Aster API wallet while the master field is blank?
questions.answer: The current guide says rotation is allowed; the app warns that without a master address it cannot share order pacing across that account's API wallets.

questions.question: Why does Aster reject a master wallet field that looks like an address?
questions.answer: Check that it is a 40-hex-character wallet address and is not identical to the API wallet address. The form points to that field when either check fails.

questions.question: Will an Aster read-only API wallet pass the connection check?
questions.answer: It may save with a clear TRADING IS BLOCKED warning because the app reads Aster's canTrade flag. Fix the credential before expecting orders.

questions.question: Does Aster account validation send a small real order?
questions.answer: No. It checks the venue's capability flags, including canTrade, without placing a test order.

questions.question: Could my Aster connection read balances yet still be unable to trade?
questions.answer: Yes. Check the account card for the TRADING IS BLOCKED warning and correct the API wallet permission before enabling live automation.

questions.question: Should I paste an Aster private key into a support screenshot?
questions.answer: No. It is a signing credential. Redact it from screenshots and reports, and rotate it if exposed.

questions.question: Can an Aster V1 API key still be used with Wick Hunter?
questions.answer: No. The current guide says the integration uses the Pro API wallet credential, not V1 keys.

questions.question: My Aster form says the master address is missing but trading still works. Is that possible?
questions.answer: Yes, an older connection can work, but it loses shared order pacing across API wallets until the master address is added.

questions.question: What should I copy before closing Aster's API wallet creation screen?
questions.answer: Save the API wallet address and private key securely; the private key is shown only once. Also identify the separate master login wallet address.

questions.question: Bybit shows all the permission boxes checked. Why is Wick Hunter refusing the key?
questions.answer: Check Bybit's READ-ONLY flag. It overrides the boxes and disables trading even when ContractTrade and other permissions appear checked.

questions.question: Does Bybit's READ-ONLY flag matter if ContractTrade is enabled?
questions.answer: Yes. The flag outranks the permission boxes; create a new key without READ-ONLY selected.

questions.question: Why can I see Bybit balances but every order gets permission denied?
questions.answer: A read-only key can read normally while Bybit refuses orders and account changes. Create a trade-enabled key and reconnect.

questions.question: What does Bybit error 10005 mean on a newly connected key?
questions.answer: The guide associates 10005 Permission denied with a key that is marked READ-ONLY despite apparently checked trading boxes. Inspect the key's top-level flag.

questions.question: Can I fix a Bybit read-only key just by ticking Derivatives?
questions.answer: No. Create a new key with READ-ONLY off; ticking permission boxes on a read-only key does not enable trading.

questions.question: Will Wick Hunter create an account using a Bybit key it knows is read-only?
questions.answer: No. The current connection check refuses that key by name rather than leaving a bot apparently running without order permission.

questions.question: My Bybit bot is quiet and the key is read-only. Could that explain it?
questions.answer: Yes. A read-only key can show normal market and balance reads but cannot place orders. Reconnect with a trade-enabled key and check Activity.

questions.question: Can I use my regular Bybit key for Bybit Demo Trading?
questions.answer: No. Make the credential inside Bybit's demo environment and choose Demo when adding that account.

questions.question: Will a Bybit Demo account appear mixed into my live account picker?
questions.answer: No. The guide says it appears as a separate account labelled DEMO.

questions.question: Does a Bybit demo trade change my real Bybit P&L?
questions.answer: No. Demo orders, positions, and P&L stay on the demo account, although market data comes from live.

questions.question: Can I select Bitget paper trading with a live Bitget key?
questions.answer: No. Create the key in Bitget's paper environment and select Demo for that account.

questions.question: Where is the Demo switch for my exchange?
questions.answer: The Environment control appears only when the selected venue has a supported demo mode. The guide documents Bybit and Bitget.

questions.question: Why does my demo account show different order results from the live market?
questions.answer: Demo orders and positions use the exchange's paper environment while the price and liquidation data still come from live. Treat fills as simulated.

questions.question: Can I compare a demo strategy with live prices in the dashboard?
questions.answer: Yes. The guide says demo orders remain separate, while candles and market feeds are from the live exchange.

questions.question: If a demo key fails, should I rotate my live key?
questions.answer: First confirm the credential was created in that venue's demo environment. A live key will not authenticate there.

questions.question: Why does Bitunix show several positions for the same pair?
questions.answer: Its per-pair Multi-Trade setting can make each order a separate position. Check that setting on Bitunix's website.

questions.question: Can Wick Hunter switch Bitunix Multi-Trade off through the API?
questions.answer: No. The guide says Bitunix exposes that control only on its website, in the pair's Cross/Isolated panel.

questions.question: What does Wick Hunter do when Bitunix reports duplicate positions on one side?
questions.answer: It treats them as a combined position, refuses new opening orders on that leg, and still allows closes while warning you.

questions.question: How do I clear the Bitunix multiple-positions warning?
questions.answer: Turn Multi-Trade off for that pair on bitunix.com and let the positions merge or close down to one. The bot then resumes on its own.

questions.question: Will disabling Bitunix Multi-Trade close the extra positions automatically?
questions.answer: The guide says positions must merge or close down to one before normal openings resume. Review them on Bitunix; do not assume the app closes them for you.

questions.question: Is a Bitunix Multi-Trade warning relevant to my Bybit account?
questions.answer: No. That notice is specific to Bitunix. Check the venue named on each warning before changing another exchange account.

questions.question: Can I still close a Bitunix position while duplicate-leg opening is blocked?
questions.answer: Yes. The app refuses further opening orders on that leg but permits closes.

questions.question: Where on Bitunix do I find the Multi-Trade setting?
questions.answer: The guide places it on bitunix.com in the pair's Cross/Isolated panel; it is not in Wick Hunter's account form.

questions.question: Will a Bitunix Multi-Trade problem resolve without restarting Wick Hunter?
questions.answer: Once the venue reports a single position for that pair and side, the bot resumes on its own.

questions.question: Why did one exchange market fail validation while another passed?
questions.answer: Each market is checked separately. Read the failed market's permission or mode warning, fix it at the exchange, then save the account again.

questions.question: Can I leave a failed market unchecked and use the rest of an account?
questions.answer: Yes. Validated markets can remain in the run plan; the failed market stays out until you correct and save it.

questions.question: Does an account warning always mean its key was rejected completely?
questions.answer: No. Some accounts save with a visible warning for a market, trade flag, or Hedge Mode. Read the specific line before deciding what to fix.

questions.question: How does the app know whether a key can trade without placing an order?
questions.answer: It checks available venue permission and capability data, such as Aster's canTrade flag; it does not submit a test order.

questions.question: Can I connect a market using read-only permission just to view balances?
questions.answer: An account may save with a warning on some venues, but automation cannot place orders there. Use a properly restricted trade-enabled key before enabling a bot.

questions.question: Where do I see whether an account is in the required position mode?
questions.answer: The account connection check reports Hedge Mode and shows a warning if the venue says the mode is unsuitable. Correct the mode before new exposure.

questions.question: Can I enable a bot while the account card says trading is blocked?
questions.answer: You may be able to configure a bot, but live trading remains blocked until you fix the exchange credential or account warning and revalidate.

questions.question: If a key is valid for Spot but not futures, will that be obvious?
questions.answer: The selected markets are validated separately. Check the market-specific warning and grant only the futures permission required for the market you use.

questions.question: Can I reuse a credential from one exchange on another?
questions.answer: No. Create the credential on the venue selected in Add account, using that venue's required fields and environment.

questions.question: What should I do after rotating an exchange API key?
questions.answer: Update the account's stored credential, revalidate its enabled markets, and check that live protection and orders can still reach the venue.

questions.question: Can I rotate a key while an open position needs protection?
questions.answer: Plan the change carefully: the app needs a valid trade-enabled key to manage that account. Review exchange-side protection and revalidate promptly.

questions.question: I revoked my API key after posting it accidentally. What next?
questions.answer: Create a replacement with restricted read and trade permissions, no withdrawals or transfers, and an IP allowlist where supported; reconnect and validate it.

questions.question: Could a connection warning be caused by the exchange's account mode rather than the key?
questions.answer: Yes. The check reports Hedge Mode separately from permission failures; read the exact account-card warning before changing credentials.

questions.question: Why does the app not silently enable a market once I fix permissions?
questions.answer: The guide says a failed market stays out of the run plan until you correct its permission and save the account again.

questions.question: What if I select several markets but only one has trading permission?
questions.answer: Each is checked independently. Use the validated market and repair the others before saving them into the run plan.

questions.question: I forgot my dashboard password. Can support tell me what it is?
questions.answer: Support should not retrieve or ask you to disclose a password. Use the documented recovery path for your installation or ask human support for safe recovery instructions.

questions.question: Is my dashboard password stored by Stripe?
questions.answer: No. Stripe handles checkout card details; your dashboard runs on your private installation with separate credentials.

questions.question: Can I use my exchange password to log into Wick Hunter?
questions.answer: No. The dashboard login is separate from your exchange account and API credential. Do not reuse or share those secrets.

questions.question: Should I email my VPS root password to support for setup help?
questions.answer: No. Describe the problem without sending a password. Human support can explain a safe troubleshooting step that does not require exposing it in chat.

questions.question: I pasted my exchange API secret into support chat. What should I do first?
questions.answer: Treat it as exposed: revoke it at the exchange, create a restricted replacement, then update and revalidate the account.

questions.question: A screenshot shows part of my API key. Is it safe to attach?
questions.answer: Redact credentials, account details, and private links before attaching a screenshot. If a secret was exposed, rotate it.

questions.question: Should I include a card number so support can find my payment?
questions.answer: No. Stripe handles full card details. Give the checkout email, invoice or transaction reference, and charge date instead.

questions.question: Can I send a one-time install token in a bug report?
questions.answer: Do not include private install tokens. Report the page and error without the credential, and use your order reference if human support needs to locate the purchase.

questions.question: Does the app keep API keys on my own server?
questions.answer: The Privacy Policy says exchange API keys and trading configuration are stored on the software installation, or on the private managed VPS if you bought hosting.

questions.question: Does the billing service ordinarily receive my positions and orders?
questions.answer: No. The Privacy Policy says keys, balances, positions, orders, and configuration are not ordinarily sent to licensing or billing. Material you voluntarily send to support is different.

questions.question: What does a licence check send to the Hub?
questions.answer: It may send a licence or installation identifier, software version, request time, and network information such as IP address to validate access and troubleshoot.

questions.question: Can Wick Hunter read my full card number?
questions.answer: Stripe handles card details; Wick Hunter receives limited payment information and identifiers needed to administer the purchase, not the full card number.

questions.question: Will my exchange key be included automatically in an AI support reply request?
questions.answer: The Privacy Policy says raw exchange account data is not automatically attached to AI support. Anything you type into chat may still be processed, so do not paste secrets.

questions.question: Does an AI assistant see the screenshots I choose to send?
questions.answer: The policy says AI-assisted chat sends recent message text and approved guide excerpts to OpenAI, not screenshots automatically. Support may receive an image you choose to submit, so redact it first.

questions.question: What information is sent to OpenAI for AI-assisted support?
questions.answer: When enabled, the Hub sends recent conversation messages and selected approved product-guide text. It does not automatically attach raw exchange account data.

questions.question: Can I avoid AI processing by not using AI-assisted support chat?
questions.answer: Yes. When AI-assisted support is enabled, recent chat messages go to OpenAI. Avoid that chat and contact human support by email if you do not want to submit a new message for AI processing; earlier messages may already have been processed.

questions.question: Does support chat use a cookie?
questions.answer: The Privacy Policy says the Hub support route may set an essential session cookie so the conversation works.

questions.question: Will the marketing site track me across other websites?
questions.answer: The reviewed marketing pages do not use advertising pixels or an analytics tag, and the policy says they are not used to track visitors across unrelated sites.

questions.question: Why did my browser remember a hosting selection?
questions.answer: The website may keep an optional hosting choice and a checkout retry identifier in local storage so a pending checkout can be retried safely.

questions.question: Are my trading settings stored on the marketing website?
questions.answer: The Privacy Policy says operational trading data is stored on the software installation or managed VPS, not ordinarily on the public marketing site.

questions.question: Does Wick Hunter sell my personal information?
questions.answer: The published Privacy Policy says it does not sell personal information for money. Review the policy for service-provider disclosures.

questions.question: How long are support messages kept?
questions.answer: Retention varies by service, legal, security, and dispute needs; the policy does not promise a fixed deletion period. Ask human support about a specific data request.

questions.question: Can I ask for my account information to be deleted?
questions.answer: Yes. Email admin@wickhunterunleashed.com. Identity verification and legal or service exceptions may apply.

questions.question: Where can I request a copy or correction of my account data?
questions.answer: Email admin@wickhunterunleashed.com with the request. Human support may need to verify your identity.

questions.question: Can a child open an Unleashed account?
questions.answer: The published Privacy Policy says the software is intended for adults and is not directed to children.

questions.question: Is a managed VPS less private than self-hosting?
questions.answer: Both store operational data on the installation. A managed VPS also involves Wick Hunter and its infrastructure provider in provisioning and support; review the Privacy Policy and hosting terms.

questions.question: Who can see my server data if I choose managed hosting?
questions.answer: The Privacy Policy says the hosted VPS and infrastructure provider process data needed to provision, secure, and support the server. Review that policy for the categories involved.

questions.question: What if I accidentally include an account identifier in a diagnostic file?
questions.answer: Review and redact files before sending. The app and Hub scrub secret-shaped values, but the policy warns that voluntarily submitted diagnostics may contain account or configuration details.

questions.question: Are bug report credentials redacted automatically?
questions.answer: The report workflow scrubs credentials and secret-shaped fields, but you should still review screenshots and text yourself before sending.

questions.question: Can I post my TradingView webhook URL in a community forum?
questions.answer: No. The URL and secret are private trading credentials. Keep them out of public posts and rotate a secret if exposed.

questions.question: Does a shared bot link reveal my Discord webhook?
questions.answer: No. Share exports trading configuration, not the Discord URL, exchange API key, or TradingView secret.

questions.question: Can I send a bot configuration file to a friend safely?
questions.answer: The Share export excludes keys and webhook secrets, but it reveals your trading rules. Preview the file yourself and share it only with someone you trust.

questions.question: Why are all my exchange keys a risk if the VPS is compromised?
questions.answer: Running accounts' keys are decrypted together in the app process. Secure the host as access to every connected account.

questions.question: Should I use the same API key for every exchange account?
questions.answer: Each account uses credentials issued by its own exchange. Keep keys restricted and separate; one server compromise can still expose all keys loaded there.

questions.question: Can a read-only exchange key reduce the risk while I trade?
questions.answer: A read-only key cannot place orders. Use only the trade permissions required for the selected market, without withdrawal or transfer access.

questions.question: If I rotate an API key, is the old key still safe to leave enabled?
questions.answer: Revoke an exposed or replaced key at the exchange after reconnecting the new restricted one. Confirm the app can still manage existing positions.

questions.question: Does an IP allowlist make withdrawal permission acceptable?
questions.answer: No. Keep withdrawals and transfers disabled even when the key is IP restricted.

questions.question: Where should I store the Aster API wallet private key?
questions.answer: Treat it as a signing secret, save it securely when created, and never send it in chat or a screenshot. Aster shows it only once.

questions.question: Can I recover an Aster private key from the app after losing it?
questions.answer: The guide says Aster shows that key once; if it was not saved, create a new API wallet and replace the credential.

questions.question: Could a support agent ask me for my full exchange secret to diagnose an issue?
questions.answer: Do not provide it. Share a redacted warning, time, market, and report instead; rotate any key you already exposed.

questions.question: Is an invoice reference enough for a billing inquiry?
questions.answer: Usually start with the checkout email, transaction or invoice reference, and charge date. Human support can request other safe details if needed.

questions.question: What happens to my account data when I remove an exchange account?
questions.answer: The app deletes its stored keys and run plan, but it cannot erase the exchange's orders or positions. Check the venue before removal.

questions.question: Can removing the account from Wick Hunter revoke its API key at the exchange?
questions.answer: No. Revoke the key in the exchange's own security settings; removing it from the app only removes the stored copy and app access.

questions.question: Does a setup export make a full credential backup?
questions.answer: No. It carries bots and settings but excludes exchange keys, Discord webhook URL, and TradingView secrets. Store recovery information separately.

questions.question: Is the setup export safe to post publicly because it excludes keys?
questions.answer: It excludes credentials but contains your bot configuration and settings. Share it only where necessary and review it first.

questions.question: Is a bot's Share link sent to a Wick Hunter server?
questions.answer: The guide says Copy link embeds the configuration in the address; opening it on another install starts Import locally, with no server or account involved in the handoff.

questions.question: Can somebody use my shared bot link to trade in my account?
questions.answer: Share carries configuration, not your API key or account authorization. Their own install must preview and save it before use.

questions.question: Does copying JSON from Share send orders?
questions.answer: No. It copies the selected bot's settings to the clipboard and leaves your account unchanged.

questions.question: Will my Discord webhook token appear in the Notifications settings page?
questions.answer: The page shows the webhook ID and only the last four token characters, not the full saved URL.

questions.question: Why does the Notifications page show no saved date for my webhook?
questions.answer: A webhook saved before the date-tracking change can show no date. The display does not reveal the full token.

questions.question: Can I retrieve the full Discord webhook URL from the browser after saving it?
questions.answer: No. The saved URL is not returned to the browser; Settings shows a masked destination summary.

questions.question: What if I set a custom Discord webhook scope but never saved a URL?
questions.answer: The Notifications page says no custom webhook is saved. Add a valid destination before expecting those messages.

questions.question: Are diagnostic screenshots guaranteed to be free of secrets after upload?
questions.answer: No. The workflow verifies image type and scrubs diagnostic text, but you must inspect and redact screenshot pixels yourself before sending.

questions.question: Can a bug report include my browser and selected market?
questions.answer: Yes. It automatically includes page, browser and viewport, selected account and market, and bounded activity context. Review the report before sending.

questions.question: If I attach diagnostics from Feedback, does it include more than Report a bug?
questions.answer: Yes. The optional diagnostics bundle can include health, recent console output, scrubbed bot settings, and debug-export context for that report.

questions.question: Can I inspect one submitted Feedback report without exporting everything?
questions.answer: Yes. The row's Export button downloads that one report. The general debug log export elsewhere covers the whole installation.

questions.question: Does Wick Hunter keep a permanent copy of my entire exchange account on the Hub?
questions.answer: The policy says exchange keys and trading data are not ordinarily sent to licensing or billing; support receives only material you choose to submit.

questions.question: Can I request deletion of a support conversation?
questions.answer: Email admin@wickhunterunleashed.com with your request. Human support may verify identity and apply legal or service retention exceptions.

questions.question: Can I opt out of transaction emails without missing licence notices?
questions.answer: Transactional messages are separate from any marketing email choice. Contact human support about delivery preferences; the policy does not promise a general opt-out from service notices.

questions.question: Does the site send marketing emails automatically after purchase?
questions.answer: The policy says marketing email is planned but not currently connected, and future marketing would require explicit opt-in. Transactional service messages are separate.

questions.question: Which company delivers licence and billing emails?
questions.answer: The Privacy Policy names Resend for transactional delivery. Check spam and contact support if an expected message is missing.

questions.question: Can I change the email address tied to my licence in chat?
questions.answer: Human support must verify ownership before changing account details. Do not post a licence token or payment credential in the conversation.

questions.question: I no longer control my purchase email. How can I regain access?
questions.answer: Contact human support with the old purchase email and transaction reference. Ownership must be verified before account changes.

questions.question: Does a support session cookie grant access to my exchange?
questions.answer: The essential Hub support cookie keeps that conversation; exchange trading remains tied to the restricted credentials on your private installation.

questions.question: Can I rely on browser local storage as a secure backup of my checkout?
questions.answer: No. It only remembers optional hosting selection and a retry identifier. Keep your purchase receipt and personal install email.

questions.question: Does the support assistant know my subscription status from a public price lookup?
questions.answer: No. Public pricing has no private account status. Check the billing portal or ask human support with an invoice reference.

questions.question: Will a support answer include my full API key if I reported a bug?
questions.answer: The report workflow redacts secret-shaped values, but review your own text and attachments before sending; never include a key intentionally.

questions.question: Should I use my exchange login password as the API secret field?
questions.answer: No. Create an API credential at the exchange for the selected venue; keep your exchange login password out of Wick Hunter and support chat.

questions.question: Do I need to give the managed-hosting team my exchange password?
questions.answer: No. They provision the server; you add restricted exchange API credentials yourself inside the private dashboard.

questions.question: Can I verify the dashboard before adding credentials?
questions.answer: Yes. Check that you are on the intended server's HTTPS address with a valid certificate, then sign in before entering restricted exchange keys.

questions.question: Where can I see which Wick Hunter version is installed?
questions.answer: Open Settings → Updates. It shows the installed version and any approved previous release offered for recovery.

questions.question: How do I return to a previous approved version?
questions.answer: In Settings → Updates, choose Return to previous version, inspect the target shown, and confirm only after planning for the restart.

questions.question: Why is Return to previous version disabled?
questions.answer: There is no compatible approved recovery release. The control explains why; it cannot select an arbitrary older build.

questions.question: Can I roll back to any release I find online?
questions.answer: No. The app offers only compatible approved recovery targets; versions before 0.90.128 are not eligible.

questions.question: Will a rollback close every open position?
questions.answer: No. Reverting does not close positions. Accounts restart and local protection logic pauses during that restart, so review exposure first.

questions.question: Do my bot settings disappear when I return to the previous version?
questions.answer: The guide says current settings, history, and trading data are kept. Verify the target and back up critical setup before proceeding.

questions.question: Does reverting interrupt stop-loss checks?
questions.answer: Local stop-loss and hedge logic pause while accounts restart. Check exchange-side protection and open exposure before reverting.

questions.question: Will my connected accounts stay logged in during a rollback?
questions.answer: All accounts restart during the revert. Allow for the temporary interruption and confirm connections afterward.

questions.question: What if the previous version fails to start after a revert?
questions.answer: The installer attempts to restore the original version. If recovery still needs attention, send a bug report; release diagnostics are attached automatically.

questions.question: Why did an update disappear from my offers after I reverted it?
questions.answer: After a successful revert, the rejected version stays out of update offers. A newer corrective release can still appear.

questions.question: What does Allow rejected update again do?
questions.answer: It removes the hold on that rejected version; it does not install the update by itself.

questions.question: Can I receive a newer fixed release after rejecting an update?
questions.answer: Yes. A newer corrective release can still be offered even while the rejected version is held back.

questions.question: Do I need to run my original install command to upgrade?
questions.answer: No. Signed updates are offered and applied from inside the app.

questions.question: Will the Update page show a release if my server has no network?
questions.answer: It needs to contact the update service to check offers. Inspect the server connection and retry; do not assume an empty offer means a release exists.

questions.question: I just updated and a setting looks wrong. What should I capture?
questions.answer: Note the installed version, expected and actual behavior, and a redacted screenshot; send Report a bug while the issue is visible.

questions.question: Does a rollback also reverse exchange trades made after the update?
questions.answer: No. Version recovery changes the software, not trades or open positions already on the exchange.

questions.question: Should I roll back while a position has only an app-managed stop?
questions.answer: Plan for a protection pause: local stop-loss and hedge logic stop during account restart. Check the exchange and human support if you cannot safely schedule it.

questions.question: Can I update without checking the release version first?
questions.answer: Settings → Updates shows the installed and offered versions. Review them and any release notes before confirming a change.

questions.question: My licence was extended. Do I need to paste a new key?
questions.answer: No. At the next Hub check-in, the app picks up and verifies the extension; Settings → License shows the new expiry.

questions.question: Do I have to reinstall to use an extended licence?
questions.answer: No. The extension is picked up on the next check-in and displayed under Settings → License.

questions.question: Where can I confirm a licence extension took effect?
questions.answer: Check Settings → License for the updated expiry after the next check-in. If it remains wrong, contact human support with the account reference.

questions.question: Can the assistant tell me the expiry date on my account?
questions.answer: That is private account state. Check Settings → License or ask human support with a reference; do not post the full licence token.

questions.question: Why does my lapsed licence still close positions?
questions.answer: The published FAQ says exit-only mode continues protection and closes existing positions while preventing new openings.

questions.question: Will renewing a lapsed subscription reopen all refused entries?
questions.answer: The published FAQ only says new openings resume when access is renewed. Check your bot state and current market conditions; it does not promise replay of missed signals.

questions.question: Does an expired licence automatically liquidate my exchange account?
questions.answer: No. The published exit-only mode protects and closes existing positions while blocking new openings; it does not promise an immediate liquidation. Check live exchange state.

questions.question: Can I move my installation without changing licence ownership?
questions.answer: Yes. Your personal install page can issue a command for a replacement server, and the licence can move, but only one installation may run at a time. Transfer your local configuration separately.

questions.question: Where is the export for moving everything to a fresh server?
questions.answer: Open Settings → Move existing setup on the old install and select Export setup.

questions.question: Which machine should I export from during a move?
questions.answer: Export from the old installation before shutting it down; import the file on the new installation.

questions.question: Does moving setup preserve all webhook secrets?
questions.answer: No. The file excludes Discord and TradingView webhook secrets as well as exchange keys; reconnect them after import.

questions.question: What if the new install already has an exchange account?
questions.answer: Import first refuses because it would overwrite existing setup. Read the warning before choosing any override.

questions.question: Can I preview the risk before overwriting a configured new install?
questions.answer: Yes. The import refuses first and explains that accounts or bots already there would be overwritten; only confirm after reviewing it.

questions.question: Does the new app reboot after importing setup?
questions.answer: Yes. The import triggers a restart and tells you which keys and webhook secrets still need reconnecting.

questions.question: Is one setup export enough to bring my exchange keys over?
questions.answer: No. It carries bots and settings, but you must reconnect every account credential on the new server.

questions.question: What should I do with the old instance before enabling bots on the new one?
questions.answer: Stop the old installation first. The move process does not fence two servers from trading the same account.

questions.question: If both installs run briefly, will the licence prevent duplicate trades?
questions.answer: Do not rely on that. The guide says moving does not fence concurrent installations from trading one exchange account.

questions.question: Does importing bot settings restore exchange-side orders exactly as they were?
questions.answer: The move file transfers configuration, not live exchange orders or secret credentials. Inspect the exchange and reconnect the account before resuming.

questions.question: Can I move from a managed VPS to my own VPS?
questions.answer: Export the setup before hosting ends, provision a supported server, and import there. Hosting cancellation does not transfer the existing VPS or its contents.

questions.question: Can I move from self-hosting to managed hosting when available?
questions.answer: Check the live hosting offer, export the old setup, import on the new server, reconnect secrets, and stop the old install before trading.

questions.question: What if my old server is gone and I never exported setup?
questions.answer: The move tool requires the export from the old install. Ask human support about any recovery options and use your own backups; do not assume the Hub holds your bot data.

questions.question: Can I use a shared bot JSON as a full disaster-recovery backup?
questions.answer: No. Share contains one bot's trading configuration; Move existing setup exports the installation's bots and settings. Neither includes exchange keys.

questions.question: Do I need the personal install page again after a server failure?
questions.answer: Yes. The personal install page issues a fresh one-time command for a replacement server. Keep the private link safe.

questions.question: My previous version button is gone after changing server. Is that normal?
questions.answer: Recovery targets depend on compatible approved releases on that installation. Check Settings → Updates and its explanation; ask support if it is unclear.

questions.question: Can I reinstall and expect old local history to reappear automatically?
questions.answer: No. A fresh server does not automatically restore local history from the old install. Use the documented move and export/import steps for supported setup before retiring the old server. If it is already lost, support can help assess what a backup may recover.

questions.question: Will reconnecting an account on a new VPS cancel its existing exchange stop orders?
questions.answer: Reconnecting is an app credential step, not an instruction to cancel exchange orders. Inspect the exchange-side book before resuming automation.

questions.question: If an update fails midway, should I repeatedly rerun the installer?
questions.answer: Use the in-app recovery status and report the failure. The guide describes an automatic attempt to restore the original version after a failed previous-release startup.

questions.question: What evidence accompanies an update-recovery bug report?
questions.answer: Release diagnostics are included automatically when recovery needs attention; describe the version change and what you observed.

questions.question: Can I opt back into a rejected build without installing it today?
questions.answer: Yes. Allow rejected update again only removes the hold; installation remains a separate step.

questions.question: Why are some older versions not valid recovery targets?
questions.answer: The guide sets a compatibility floor and offers only approved previous releases. A build before 0.90.128 cannot be used as a recovery target.

questions.question: Does returning to a previous version restore my old account password?
questions.answer: The rollback keeps current settings, history, and trading data; it is not documented as a password-reset tool. Ask human support for account recovery.

questions.question: Is a license extension applied even if I miss the email?
questions.answer: The app checks the Hub, verifies the extended key, and displays the new expiry at the next check-in; no manual paste is needed.

questions.question: Could a failed account validation be fixed by reinstalling?
questions.answer: Reinstalling is not the first fix. Read the market and permission warning, correct the exchange credential or mode, then revalidate.

questions.question: Can I retire orphaned bots after migrating away from an old exchange account?
questions.answer: My Bots lists bots stranded by a removed account with a Retire action. Check the exchange for leftover orders first.

questions.question: Do older closed trades lose their bot name when I retire an orphan?
questions.answer: No. Retirement keeps the name for historical P&L attribution.

questions.question: What if I removed an account before closing a live position?
questions.answer: The app cannot manage that exchange account without its key. Check the venue directly and restore a valid connection if you need app management.

questions.question: Does account removal erase the evidence that I overrode an exposure warning?
questions.answer: No. Activity and notifications record what account, market, and exposure you left behind.

questions.question: Where is the bug report form in the app?
questions.answer: Open Help → Report a bug while the problem is visible. State what you expected and what happened.

questions.question: How much detail should I write in a bug report?
questions.answer: Include the action you took, expected result, actual result, and when it happened. The form attaches bounded technical context automatically.

questions.question: Should I report a bug before or after restarting the app?
questions.answer: If possible, send it while the issue is visible so the automatic Activity and browser context describe the failure.

questions.question: Can I attach a screenshot to Report a bug?
questions.answer: Yes. PNG, JPEG, and WebP screenshots are supported; inspect the image for secrets before sending it.

questions.question: Why did the app resize my screenshot before sending?
questions.answer: The source image may be up to 20 MB, but evidence is limited to 2 MB; the browser resizes and recompresses oversized images locally.

questions.question: What if my screenshot is larger than the 20 MB source limit?
questions.answer: The documented form accepts source images up to 20 MB. Reduce the image size before attaching it, then review it for secrets.

questions.question: Can I attach a PDF instead of an image to Report a bug?
questions.answer: The documented picture formats are PNG, JPEG, and WebP. Use one of those for an image; ask human support how to share other evidence.

questions.question: Can I attach a video file to the bug form?
questions.answer: The guide documents raster screenshots, not video attachments. Describe the sequence and ask human support about another safe way to provide video.

questions.question: Does Report a bug include recent Activity automatically?
questions.answer: Yes. It attaches a bounded tail with ISO time, account context, bot, event kind, and symbol where known.

questions.question: Why is an older Activity event missing from my report?
questions.answer: The evidence budget drops the oldest rows when full and states the included time range and row count.

questions.question: Will the bug report say which account and market I was viewing?
questions.answer: Yes. It includes the selected account and market, plus page, browser, and viewport context.

questions.question: Does a bug report automatically list every open deal?
questions.answer: It includes bounded counts and summaries of managed deals and read-only hedge attachments, not an unlimited raw account export.

questions.question: Will Report a bug send my entire browser console history?
questions.answer: The standard report includes bounded context. The optional Feedback diagnostics bundle can add recent console output and broader debug data for that report.

questions.question: What does Attach diagnostics in the Feedback board add?
questions.answer: It builds a fuller bundle with app health, recent console output, scrubbed running-bot settings, and debug-export context for that one report.

questions.question: Can a new-process bug report include the previous boot's console output?
questions.answer: The optional Feedback diagnostics bundle includes the previous boot's recent console output when the process is still young.

questions.question: Where do I open the app's own Feedback board?
questions.answer: Use the Feedback page or New feedback control, then choose Attach diagnostics if the fuller bundle is useful and safe to send.

questions.question: Does selecting Attach diagnostics upload information immediately?
questions.answer: It builds a bundle in the background and attaches it to that report. Review the report before submitting sensitive context.

questions.question: Can I export just one Feedback report?
questions.answer: Yes. The row's Export button downloads that single report as one file.

questions.question: What is the difference between row Export and Export debug log?
questions.answer: Row Export downloads one feedback report; Settings' general debug export covers the whole installation.

questions.question: Could an older Hub silently drop my screenshot but say the report succeeded?
questions.answer: The app requires the Hub to confirm evidence format v2 before accepting a report with the new evidence, so it cannot silently claim success.

questions.question: Does the Hub also scrub report text?
questions.answer: Yes. The app redacts secret-shaped fields and the Hub scrubs report text and diagnostic values again. Still review what you send.

questions.question: Can I rely on automatic scrubbing for a visible password in a screenshot?
questions.answer: No. Redact screenshot pixels yourself; automatic text scrubbing is not a promise to remove secrets already visible in an image.

questions.question: Why was my screenshot rejected as an image?
questions.answer: The Hub accepts genuine raster images in the supported formats. Convert a screenshot to PNG, JPEG, or WebP and retry after checking privacy.

questions.question: Can I mention an exact order time instead of sharing my API key?
questions.answer: Yes. Give the time, exchange, market, expected action, and observed warning. A key is unnecessary for a useful report.

questions.question: Should I include a transaction ID for a billing bug?
questions.answer: Provide a safe invoice or transaction reference and charge date to human billing support; never include the full card number.

questions.question: Can AI support approve a refund from a chat message?
questions.answer: No. Human billing support must review actual payment records and the refund request under the current policy.

questions.question: How do I request a human review of a charge?
questions.answer: Email admin@wickhunterunleashed.com with the checkout email, charge date, invoice reference, and a concise explanation.

questions.question: Can support guarantee an exchange order will fill after I report it?
questions.answer: No. The Terms do not guarantee exchange execution or order fills. Give human support the rejection details and time so the issue can be investigated.

questions.question: Is there a public email address for account support?
questions.answer: The published Terms and policies list admin@wickhunterunleashed.com. Do not include passwords or API secrets in the message.

questions.question: What should I send if the installer failed before I reached the dashboard?
questions.answer: Describe the server OS, step, error text, and purchase reference without the private install token or passwords. Human support can review the failure.

questions.question: Can I include the private install command in a support ticket?
questions.answer: Do not send the private token. Report the failing step and redacted error output; human support can use your order reference.

questions.question: Will support know my VPS password from the purchase?
questions.answer: The software purchase does not make your VPS login a support credential. Do not disclose it; explain the issue without the password.

questions.question: What if the bug report page itself will not load?
questions.answer: Use the published support email with the page, approximate time, version if known, and a redacted description.

questions.question: Can I send a report even if I cannot reproduce the error now?
questions.answer: Yes, but include the approximate time, expected and actual result, and any Activity evidence you have. Automatic context is most useful while the issue is visible.

questions.question: Why did Support ask what I expected, not just what broke?
questions.answer: Comparing expected and actual behavior helps separate a defect from a rule or exchange refusal; include both in Report a bug.

questions.question: Should I report a rejected market as a bug immediately?
questions.answer: First read the market-specific permission or account-mode warning and revalidate. If it remains inconsistent, send the warning and context without credentials.

questions.question: A bot did nothing, but I have no error text. What evidence helps?
questions.answer: Note the time, account, market, bot, and expected action, then review Activity and include a redacted screenshot or report.

questions.question: Can I attach a screenshot from the exchange's website?
questions.answer: The bug form supports genuine PNG, JPEG, or WebP images. Redact account IDs, balances, and secrets you do not need to share.

questions.question: Should I submit the same bug repeatedly while the spinner runs?
questions.answer: Wait for a clear success or failure. If it fails, retry with the same description and avoid exposing additional secrets; human support can review uncertain submissions.

questions.question: What if a bug report claims success but I do not see a reply?
questions.answer: The report is an evidence submission, not an immediate fix. Keep its reference if shown and contact human support with the submission time.

questions.question: Can support see my account balances without me sending diagnostics?
questions.answer: The Privacy Policy says trading balances are not ordinarily sent to the licensing or billing service. Support sees what you choose to share.

questions.question: Is support chat free even if AI credits are empty?
questions.answer: The app describes support chat as free. AI reply eligibility may change; human support remains the route for account-specific issues.

questions.question: Why did I get a human support handoff instead of an AI answer?
questions.answer: Some account-specific or sensitive issues need human review. Give a concise summary and safe references, without credentials or full payment details.

questions.question: Can I ask support to review a screenshot before I send it?
questions.answer: You should inspect and redact it yourself first. Support can then review the submitted image as part of your request.

questions.question: What can I safely share to diagnose a login problem?
questions.answer: Share the dashboard URL without private tokens, the error wording, browser, and time. Do not send passwords, recovery codes, or API keys.

questions.question: What if my report includes the wrong selected account?
questions.answer: Correct the narrative with the intended exchange and market; the automatic context reflects the selected account when the report was created.

questions.question: How precise should my bug timestamp be?
questions.answer: Include a time and timezone if you can. The automatic Activity tail uses ISO times, which helps align it with the event.

questions.question: Can I describe an intermittent problem even if it recovered?
questions.answer: Yes. Give the last time it happened, duration, expected behavior, and any warning or Activity entry; a redacted screenshot can help.

questions.question: What if I only have an exchange rejection code?
questions.answer: Include the code, venue, market, time, and what you attempted. Do not include your API secret.

questions.question: Does a Feedback export replace my own server backup?
questions.answer: No. It exports one report; use the setup move export and your own backup process for installation recovery.

questions.question: Can I send a general debug export to support without checking it?
questions.answer: Review it first. Even scrubbed diagnostics can contain account or configuration details you may not need to share.

questions.question: Could an AI answer diagnose a specific exchange fill without my account data?
questions.answer: It can explain documented behavior, but a specific fill needs exchange and Activity evidence. Share safe details or request human review.

questions.question: What should I do if I have an urgent open-position problem?
questions.answer: Check the exchange directly first for live orders and protection, then contact human support with safe account, market, and time details.

questions.question: Is support allowed to ask for my full card number to verify me?
questions.answer: Do not send it. Stripe handles card details; use the checkout email and transaction reference for human billing review.

questions.question: Can I use the report form to request a licence extension?
questions.answer: A bug report captures technical evidence; licence changes are account-specific. Contact human support with your purchase reference.

questions.question: Does a report attachment leave my computer before I press Send?
questions.answer: The guide says oversized images are resized and recompressed on your device before sending. Review the final evidence before submission.

questions.question: What is evidence format v2 for?
questions.answer: It lets the Hub confirm it understands the report's screenshot and diagnostic format before accepting that evidence.

questions.question: Does a standard bug report include all my bot settings?
questions.answer: No. The standard report has bounded Activity and deal context; the optional Feedback diagnostics bundle can add scrubbed settings for running bots.

questions.question: Can a screenshot include a QR code for an API key if I blur the text?
questions.answer: No. Treat QR codes and other secret representations as credentials; remove them entirely before sharing the image.

questions.question: What if I reported a secret by mistake and cannot edit the message?
questions.answer: Revoke or rotate the exposed credential promptly, then notify human support with the report reference without repeating the secret.

questions.question: Can I use the support chat to send a feature request?
questions.answer: You can describe the desired behavior and use the Feedback page for an app report. Avoid account secrets and say what workflow the request would improve.

questions.question: How do I tell support a problem only happens on my phone?
questions.answer: Include the device/browser, page, viewport or orientation, time, and expected versus actual behavior. The report automatically captures browser and viewport context.

questions.question: Can a redacted report still include useful bot context?
questions.answer: Yes. The standard report includes bounded Activity and deal summaries; optional diagnostics can include scrubbed running-bot settings.

questions.question: Who reviews a question about whether my refund is legally required?
questions.answer: Human billing support must assess the purchase and applicable law. The voluntary policy does not remove mandatory rights.

questions.question: The dashboard URL will not open. What should I check first?
questions.answer: Confirm the VPS is online, use the HTTPS URL printed by the installer or sent for managed hosting, and check the browser's exact error before sharing a redacted report.

questions.question: My dashboard suddenly shows a certificate error. Is it safe to bypass?
questions.answer: No. Do not enter a password or exchange key until the HTTPS certificate issue is resolved. Contact human support with the error wording if needed.

questions.question: The page is blank after I updated. What should I capture?
questions.answer: Note the installed version, page URL, browser error, and time; use Report a bug or human support without sharing credentials.

questions.question: Why does the app say my exchange connection is healthy but trading is blocked?
questions.answer: Some read checks can succeed with a non-trading key. Read the account card's trading warning and revalidate a properly permissioned key.

questions.question: A new account says one market was skipped. Did the app forget my selection?
questions.answer: No. Each market validates separately, and a failed one stays out of the run plan until its permission or mode is fixed and saved again.

questions.question: I changed my exchange key and now the account warns about permissions. What next?
questions.answer: Verify the new key's trade permission, environment, market scope, and IP allowlist, then revalidate the account.

questions.question: The account screen says Hedge Mode is wrong. Should I ignore it?
questions.answer: No. The account check reports position mode because the bots require a compatible mode before exposure. Correct it at the venue and revalidate.

questions.question: The account picker says DEMO, but I expected live. What should I verify?
questions.answer: Check the Environment selected when the account was added and whether the key came from the venue's demo environment. Demo is separate from live.

questions.question: My demo chart has real-market candles. Is the demo broken?
questions.answer: No. Demo orders and P&L are separate, while candles and liquidation feed come from the live venue.

questions.question: Why are there no bots under an account I removed?
questions.answer: Removing the account leaves its bots without a market card. My Bots lists them as orphaned entries you can inspect or retire.

questions.question: I retired an orphaned bot, but an exchange order is still open. Why?
questions.answer: Retire affects this installation's bot list only. It does not cancel orders or close exchange positions; use the exchange screen.

questions.question: Why did the app warn me twice when removing an account?
questions.answer: It found open deals, armed hedge stops, or uncertain submissions. The second confirmation names what and where, because removal will end app access without closing them.

questions.question: The Guided setup panel points nowhere. Is it stuck?
questions.answer: It says when the target page or control is not open or visible. Open that page, or use Next; the tour does not wait for an action.

questions.question: Why did Next advance before I added an account?
questions.answer: Guided setup is informational. It does not wait for keys, saves, or trades before advancing.

questions.question: My new bot Save lists empty fields. Is that a server error?
questions.answer: No. New bots start with blank numeric and name fields, and Save refuses a missing required value rather than inventing a risk default.

questions.question: Why did my edited bot refuse to save after I cleared one number?
questions.answer: A missing required value makes Save refuse the form rather than silently restoring an old number or inserting a risk default. Enter the intended value and save again.

questions.question: I received an exchange sync DEGRADED notice after a brief outage. Why was it delayed?
questions.answer: The notice is sent only after account reads have failed for more than a minute; shorter failures may stay only in service logs.

questions.question: Why was a brief exchange sync failure not in Activity?
questions.answer: Sync failures that recover inside the notice window are kept in the service journal, without a notification or Activity entry.

questions.question: How does the app decide an exchange sync is RESTORED?
questions.answer: It waits for two successful passes before sending the RESTORED notice, avoiding a card for a one-read recovery.

questions.question: What does local sync DELAYED mean?
questions.answer: It identifies the app's own polling budget as the cause and says nothing was sent to the exchange.

questions.question: Is a local sync DELAYED card the same as an exchange refusing my order?
questions.answer: No. It says the app's local polling budget delayed a read and that no exchange request was sent for that event.

questions.question: Why did no price-feed alert arrive during a two-minute gap?
questions.answer: Price-feed alerts wait five minutes before notifying; Activity and the service log still note a gap once it passes 75 seconds.

questions.question: When does PRICE FEED MISSING become a notification?
questions.answer: If the gap persists for five minutes. The card then reports its actual age and groups pairs affected by the same feed request.

questions.question: Why does one price-feed alert mention many pairs?
questions.answer: On some venues one request prices many pairs, so one refusal is grouped into one card listing the affected pairs.

questions.question: Why did the price-feed card list only some symbols then say plus more?
questions.answer: It gives a compact list and a count for the grouped pairs instead of sending a separate card for each one.

questions.question: What does PRICE FEED FLAPPING mean?
questions.answer: The feed has repeatedly gone missing and recovered. The guide describes a folded notice rather than separate cards for every brief cycle.

questions.question: Are feed warnings suppressed right after an account starts?
questions.answer: Yes. Sync and price-feed cards are held for the first ten minutes; a problem still present afterward is reported with its real age.

questions.question: My startup price-feed gap cleared after eight minutes. Should a Discord warning still arrive?
questions.answer: Usually no. Startup sync and feed notifications are held for ten minutes, and a wobble that clears during that window sends no card.

questions.question: Why did a startup warning arrive with an age older than the card?
questions.answer: A problem still present after the ten-minute startup hold is reported then with its actual age, not reset to zero.

questions.question: Can I turn off deal-closed notifications without turning off every alert?
questions.answer: Yes. In Settings → Notifications, turn off Deal closed; it also stops the preliminary Closed — reconciling card.

questions.question: Where do I change which Discord alerts Wick Hunter sends?
questions.answer: Open Settings → Notifications. Five message toggles control deal opens, DCA fills, deal closes, hedge events, and system alerts.

questions.question: Are notification toggles separate for each account?
questions.answer: The guide says each of the five message toggles applies to every bot, account, and market on this installation.

questions.question: Why did I receive a deal alert when I never changed notification settings?
questions.answer: The five message categories are on by default until you turn them off in Settings → Notifications.

questions.question: Can I add wallet balance to every close card?
questions.answer: In Settings → Notifications, enable Wallet under Include on close cards. It is off by default, so only opt in if you want that information in messages.

questions.question: Why is Daily P&L missing from my close alert?
questions.answer: The Daily P&L inclusion toggle ships off. Enable it under Settings → Notifications if you want that line.

questions.question: Can I include Total P&L without including Wallet?
questions.answer: Yes. Wallet, Daily P&L, and Total P&L close-card options are independent toggles.

questions.question: A close alert omits Wallet even though I enabled it. Is that zero balance?
questions.answer: No. If the app has not fetched a wallet figure, it omits the line rather than claiming your balance is zero.

questions.question: Why does a close card show Daily P&L as zero but no Wallet line?
questions.answer: Zero can be a known fact when there are no closes today. A missing wallet reading is omitted instead of shown as zero.

questions.question: Does a close card show the account I am browsing or the one that traded?
questions.answer: It shows figures from the account named in that card's exchange and market footer, not another account you happen to view.

questions.question: Why did the balance on an updated close card change?
questions.answer: Wallet is read when the card is sent or updated, so a later settled-profit edit may show a later balance.

questions.question: What does NATIVE CORE DEGRADED mean in a notification?
questions.answer: It applies only to an install using the compiled decision core in authoritative mode. It means that core stopped answering a hedge or deal decision.

questions.question: Will native-core failure open a new trade anyway?
questions.answer: No. During that failure, the guide says affected hedge and deal decisions hold existing levels and resting orders and open nothing new until the core answers.

questions.question: Why have I never seen a NATIVE CORE card?
questions.answer: That operator-enabled authoritative mode is off by default. The notice appears only on installations running it.

questions.question: How long does the app wait before notifying about native-core degradation?
questions.answer: It uses the same five-minute dwell and initial ten-minute startup hold as price-feed cards.

questions.question: What does an unattributed add notice mean?
questions.answer: The exchange position changed beyond rounding and the app could not tie it to one of its own orders. It adopts the venue's figures but cannot identify who caused the change.

questions.question: Does an unattributed reduce prove somebody manually traded?
questions.answer: No. A manual trade, liquidation, auto-deleverage, or venue action can look the same; the app does not claim a cause it cannot know.

questions.question: Why did my own DCA fill not trigger an unattributed notice?
questions.answer: A change tied to a known resting order is handled as that order's fill, without an extra unattributed alert.

questions.question: I did not trade, but an unattributed add appeared. What should I check?
questions.answer: Open the exchange for that pair and amount. The notice says the app cannot identify the cause from position data alone.

questions.question: My support chat is blank after the server goes offline. Where should I start?
questions.answer: Verify the server and HTTPS dashboard first. If the app remains unreachable, use the published support email without sharing credentials.

questions.question: Why does a failed exchange account not appear as a trading market?
questions.answer: A market that failed validation is left out of the run plan until you fix its permission and save the account again.

questions.question: The site pricing card and checkout total differ. Which is authoritative?
questions.answer: Review the live checkout summary for the selected plan, discount, hosting, tax, and payment method. Contact human billing support if the mismatch remains.

questions.question: A promised hosting option is missing from checkout. Can support turn it on?
questions.answer: Hosting is offered only when live checkout or the customer dashboard confirms availability. Ask human support about alternatives; do not assume a past page guarantees it.

questions.question: My new server is installed but licence expiry looks old. What should I do?
questions.answer: Check Settings → License after the next Hub check-in. If an extension still does not appear, contact human support with your purchase reference.

questions.question: The browser says my install page token is invalid. Should I paste it here?
questions.answer: No. Reopen your personal page for a fresh command, or contact human support with the order reference without revealing the token.

questions.question: Can I keep deal-open alerts but turn off system alerts?
questions.answer: Yes. Settings → Notifications has independent toggles for Deal opened and System alerts; change one without disabling the other.

questions.question: How do I tell an exchange sync warning from a missing price-feed warning?
questions.answer: A sync warning concerns account reads; a price-feed warning concerns missing market prices for named pairs. Read the card title, account, market, and age before troubleshooting.
